With the fall of {0}, the mountain forge fires that had burned for a thousand years went out. The ancient dragon, kept asleep by the forges' heat, is said to have awakened. The Dragon's Lair has appeared on the map.

ニュース.🌑 <b>{0}が、門から溢れた黒い霧に呑まれた。</b>守備兵の多くが、霧の中: 🌑 {0} was swallowed by the black mist overflowing from the gate. They say many of the garrison walked into the mist and never came back.
ニュース.倒れた冒険者たち（{0}）の亡骸も消えた。: The bodies of fallen adventurers ({0}) have vanished too.

地の文.今日はもう聞いてもらえない: They won't listen to you again today
地の文.成功で今回の買値2割引。失敗すると1割増し: Success: 20% off this purchase. Failure: 10% more
地の文.宿もいいが、たまには野宿してみな。シルヴァの森なら、朝には枯れ枝が山ほど拾える。: Inns are nice, but try sleeping rough now and then. In the Silva forest you'll find heaps of dry branches by morning. That's how all the archers make their arrows.
地の文.ドルガンの岩山で夜を明かした鉱夫は、朝に鉄鉱石を拾って帰るそうだ。宿代より安い稼: They say miners who spend the night on Dorgan's crags pick up iron ore in the morning. Cheaper than paying for an inn.
地の文.ルーメの高原で野営すると、朝露の中に光る石が落ちていることがあるらしい。魔導師ど: Camp on the Lume highlands and you might find glowing stones in the morning dew. The kind of thing that makes mages' eyes light up.
地の文.ベルカの浜で一晩過ごしゃ、朝には魚が打ち上がってる。運がよけりゃ、宝石だってな。: Spend a night on the Belka shore and there'll be fish washed up by morning. If you're lucky, even gems.
地の文.{0}と{1}は戦の最中だ。街道で軍勢に出くわしても、評判さえ悪くなければ手は出: {0} and {1} are at war. Even if you run into their armies on the road, they won't touch you as long as your reputation isn't bad.
地の文.南の結界が弱まっているらしい。あと{0}日もすれば……いや、縁起でもない。: They say the southern barrier is weakening. In another {0} days... no, don't even say it.
地の文.南の結界はな、千年前にアルデンの騎士様たちが魔族を追い詰めて張ったんだと。力の強: The southern barrier, see — a thousand years ago the knights of Arden drove the demons back and raised it. The stronger the demon, the harder it keeps them out. The Demon Lord can't take a single step out, and his power's been sapped. Only ravens and imps can slip through.
地の文.魔王軍は日ごとに数を増している。今や{0}つの拠点が奴らの手の中だ。: The Demon Army grows by the day. They now hold {0} locations.
地の文.一国ずつでは魔王軍に勝てん。だが王たちは互いにいがみ合っている。誰か、王に顔の利: No single nation can beat the Demon Army. But the kings are at each other's throats. If someone with the kings' ear went around preaching alliance... three nations together could push them back.
地の文.昔、喚ばれた異邦人が元の世界へ帰ったという話がある。どうやったのかは、遺跡の壁画: There's a tale of a summoned stranger who went back to their own world, long ago. How they did it — the murals in the ruins, or the sage in the hermitage nearby, might know.
地の文.異邦人を喚んだのはルーメの魔導師たちだ。帰り道のことも、あの国の大導師なら知って: It was the mages of Lume who summoned the strangers. Their Archmage ought to know the way back too. If you're in her good graces, that is.
地の文.星降りの迷宮の底に、異界の門について記した石碑があるそうだ。番人は岩の塊で、刃が: They say there's a stone tablet about the Otherworld Gate at the bottom of the Starfall Labyrinth. The guardian's a lump of rock that blades barely scratch.
地の文.異界の門が開くのは召喚から{0}日目だろう？ 開いているのはほんの数日だけらしい: The Otherworld Gate opens on day {0} after the summoning, right? I hear it only stays open a few days.
地の文.道具は鞄の中で隣り合わせると力を発揮する。砥石は刃物の隣、矢筒は弓の隣、魔石は魔: Tools show their power when placed side by side in your bag. Whetstones next to blades, quivers next to bows, mana stones next to grimoires.
地の文.魔族の仮面というものがある。あれを鞄に入れていれば、魔王軍の占領地でも同族として: There's a thing called a demon mask. With one in your bag, you can walk through Demon Army territory as one of their own. Demon knights carry them, they say, or the sage keeps one hidden.
地の文.首都には空き店舗がある。600Gあれば店を持って暮らしていけるぞ。: There are empty shops in the capitals. With 600G you could own a shop and make a living.
地の文.どこかの国で評判を10まで上げれば、騎士に取り立ててもらえるそうだ。: Raise your reputation with a nation to 10 and they say you'll be made a knight.
地の文.鞄の中で品物同士を重ねてみな。相性が良ければ、別の品に作り変えられる。何と何が合: Try stacking items on top of each other in your bag. If they suit each other, they turn into something new. What goes with what — you'll have to find out yourself.
地の文.野営すると、朝にその土地の品を拾える。森なら枝、山なら鉄鉱石、浜なら魚。宿では手: If you camp, you'll find local goods in the morning. Branches in the forest, iron ore in the mountains, fish on the shore. Pickings you won't get at an inn. With a fishing rod you can fish at villages, Port Town Mira, and the pond by the Sage's Hermitage. Lockpicks come in handy for locked chests in dungeons.
地の文.ごく稀に、深い迷宮の底で黄金の果実が見つかる。食べれば力が永久に増すそうだ。: Very rarely, a golden fruit is found at the bottom of a deep labyrinth. They say eating it makes you permanently stronger.
地の文.交易品は産地で安く買い、欲しがる国で売れ。ベルカの香辛料、ドルガンの地酒、シルヴ: Buy trade goods cheap where they're made and sell them where they're wanted. Belka's spices, Dorgan's ale, Silva's herbs.
地の文.ベルカの古い家には、たいてい一人は「海から来た」ご先祖がいるって話だ。どこの海か: They say most old Belka families have at least one ancestor who "came from the sea". Which sea? Who knows. That's the one thing the old folks won't talk about.
地の文.アルデンの麦畑の外れ: the edge of Arden's wheat fields
地の文.畑の畦に、落ち枝や木の実が転がっている。: Fallen branches and nuts lie along the field paths.
地の文.流木と、打ち上げられた魚。潮だまりで何かが光った気がする。: Driftwood and washed-up fish. Something seemed to glint in a tide pool.
地の文.森は恵みにあふれている。枯れ枝も薬草も、拾い放題だ。: The forest is full of bounty. Dry branches and herbs, as much as you like.
地の文.崩れた岩肌に、鉄の筋が走っている。: Veins of iron run through the crumbling rock face.
地の文.高原の草は露に濡れている。岩陰で、淡く光る石を見かけた。: The highland grass is wet with dew. You spotted a faintly glowing stone in the shadow of a rock.
地の文.焦げた大地。拾えるのは物騒なものばかりだ。: Scorched earth. Everything you can pick up here is dangerous.
地の文.朝露の草原。枝と木の実を拾い集めた。: Grassland in the morning dew. You gathered branches and nuts.

地の文.「なら、これだけでも持っていって。あの子が使っていたものだ」: "Then at least take this. It's something that one used."

地の文.体の部品も一緒に受け取った（鞄に置いて、枠に入れ直そう）。: You also received its body parts (place them in your bag and put them back in the frame).
地の文.鞄はもう広げられない: the bag can't grow any more
地の文.その夜、申し合わせたわけでもないのに、彼らは同じ焚き火を囲んでいた。{0}。信条: That night, without anyone arranging it, they found themselves around the same fire. {0}. People of different beliefs, different masters, different homes. On another day they might well have drawn swords on each other.
地の文.誰かが笑って言った。「妙な話だ。全員、同じ異邦人に借りがある」: Someone laughed and said, "Funny, isn't it. Every one of us owes the same stranger."
地の文.酒が回り、干し肉が回り、やがて一人ずつ、焚き火越しにあなたへ杯を掲げた。喚ばれて: The drink went round, the jerky went round, and one by one they raised their cups to you across the fire. The "dud" who was summoned and thrown away. — That dud had shaken more hands than anyone in this world.
地の文.空いた席に、誰かがそっと杯を置いた。ここにいない者の分だ。: Someone quietly set a cup at an empty seat. For those who weren't there.
地の文.「困ったら呼べ。どこにいても行く」 その言葉が、全員の口から出た。: "If you're in trouble, call. Wherever I am, I'll come." Every one of them said it.
地の文.水たまりに映った自分の顔が、一瞬、知らない誰かのものに見えた。: For an instant, the face reflected in a puddle looked like someone you didn't know.
地の文.すれ違った子どもが、目を合わせるなり母親の陰に隠れた。: A child you passed hid behind their mother the moment your eyes met.
地の文.夜、焚き火の向こうの闇が、こちらを手招きしている気がした。: At night, the darkness beyond the campfire seemed to beckon you.

地の文.賢者の言葉を思い出し、胸の継ぎ目に刃を突き立てた。束ねられた腕が、一瞬ばらばらに: Remembering the sage's words, you drove your blade into the seam at its chest. The bound arms thrashed apart for an instant.
地の文.継ぎ合わされた身体がほどけ、喚ばれた者たちの影が、ひとつずつ光になって昇っていっ: The stitched body came undone, and the shadows of the summoned rose one by one as light. Zeno's face, left last, crumbled while trying to say something.
地の文.「サヨナラ！」——それが、導師ゼノの最後の言葉だった。ニンジャは喚ばれた者たちの: "Sayonara!" — those were Master Zeno's last words. The Ninja watched the light of the summoned rise, and quietly put their hands together. "...Otassha de."

地の文.道の先に、白と青の装束の騎士が立っていた。抜き身の剣が、陽を跳ね返している。: Ahead on the road stood a knight in white and blue. His drawn sword flashed in the sun.
地の文.が、怒りに任せて斬りかかってきた！: strikes at you in a fury!
地の文.膝をついたリオネルは、血に濡れた手で剣を拾い直した。: Lionel, on his knees, picked up his sword again with a bloodied hand.
地の文.とどめを刺す前に、王子は馬に飛び乗り、霧の中へ消えた。<span class=\: Before you could finish him, the prince leapt onto his horse and vanished into the mist. (Lionel will appear again someday)
地の文.焚き火の煙の向こうに、黒い外套の男が座っていた。外套の下の鎧は傷だらけで、胸の獅: Beyond the smoke of the campfire sat a man in a black cloak. The armor beneath was covered in scars, and the lion crest on his chest had been scraped off.
地の文.リオネルは、それきり動かなくなった。剣の柄には、鴉の羽が一本、結わえられていた。: Lionel moved no more. A single raven feather was tied to the hilt of his sword.
地の文.{0}が旗を立てた土地。兵の天幕と、小さな市が立っている。: Land where {0} has raised its flag. Soldiers' tents and a small market stand here.
地の文.{0}の旗が翻っている。元は{1}の地だ。: {0}'s flag flies here. This was once {1}'s land.
地の文.門番が槍を交差させた。「お前の顔は手配書で見たぞ。失せろ」: The gatekeepers crossed their spears. "I've seen your face on a wanted poster. Get lost."
地の文.「その手は食わん。次に顔を見せたら牢屋行きだ」: "I'm not falling for that. Show your face again and it's prison."
地の文.「……確かに手配書の人相とは違うか。通れ」 門番は首をひねりながら槍を引いた。: "...You don't quite match the wanted poster, I suppose. Go on." The gatekeeper tilted his head and pulled back his spear.
地の文.門番は金を数え、顔を背けた。「……今回だけだ」: The gatekeeper counted the money and looked away. "...Just this once."
地の文.夜明け前、宿の主人に揺り起こされた。「裏口から逃げな！」 休む間もなく、物陰を伝: Before dawn, the innkeeper shook you awake. "Out the back door, quick!" With no time to rest, you slipped through the shadows and out of town.
地の文.温かい食事と寝台。体力が全快した。: A warm meal and a bed. Fully recovered.
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">一杯やって、少し人心地がついた。（HP+: You had a drink and felt a little more human. (HP +{0})
地の文.🌳 世界樹の木陰で休む: 🌳 Rest in the shade of the World Tree
地の文.🌳 世界樹の根元へ行く: 🌳 Go to the roots of the World Tree
地の文.精霊が助けを求めているらしい: A spirit seems to be asking for help
地の文.8人の勝ち抜き。優勝で{0}Gと褒美・評判+{1}。{2}日に1度: 8-person knockout. The champion gets {0}G, a reward and reputation +{1}. Once every {2} days
地の文.魔王を討った英雄として: as the hero who slew the Demon Lord
地の文.魔王討伐を支えた者として: as one who supported the Demon Lord's defeat
地の文.人目のない物陰で、預かった包みの紐をほどいた。「中身は見るなよ」——受付の声が、: In a secluded corner, you untied the cord of the package you were entrusted with. "Don't look inside" — the receptionist's voice echoed in your ears.
地の文.中には、封蝋をした革袋。ずしりと重い銀貨が詰まっていた。: Inside was a wax-sealed leather pouch, heavy with silver coins.
地の文.油紙で丁寧にくるんだ品が入っていた。: Inside was an item carefully wrapped in oiled paper.
地の文.柔らかな布にくるまれて、小さな宝石がひとつ。どこかの商人の、大事な取引の品だった: Wrapped in soft cloth was a single small gem. It must have been some merchant's important trade goods.
地の文.包みの中身は、誰かに宛てた恋文の束だった。……読まなかったことにして、焚き火にく: The package held a bundle of love letters addressed to someone. ...You pretended you hadn't read them and fed them to the campfire.
地の文.中身は、古びた帳簿と、押し花をはさんだ手紙だった。金目のものは何もない。: Inside were an old ledger and a letter with a pressed flower. Nothing of value.
地の文.ギルドの受付が包みを差し出した。「{0}まで頼む。中身は見るなよ」: The guild receptionist held out a package. "To {0}, please. And don't look inside."
地の文.依頼は失敗だ。ギルドの受付は肩をすくめた。: The job failed. The guild receptionist shrugged.
地の文.「異邦人よ、そなたの働きは聞き及んでいる。アルデンの剣は、義ある者を拒まぬ」: "Stranger, I have heard of your deeds. The sword of Arden does not turn away the righteous."
地の文.「……よかろう。騎士の国が他国と轡を並べるのは、結界を張った千年前以来か。異邦人: "...Very well. Has it been since the barrier was raised a thousand years ago that the nation of knights rode beside other nations? The stranger's words have reason."
地の文.「他国と手を組めだと？ 昨日まで矢を射かけてきた連中とか」 獅子王は首を振った。: "Join hands with other nations? With those who were shooting arrows at us only yesterday?" The Lion King shook his head.
地の文.「膝をつけ、異邦人。——立て、アルデンの騎士よ」 剣の平が肩に触れた。: "Kneel, stranger. — Rise, knight of Arden." The flat of the sword touched your shoulder.
地の文.「今は剣を向ける相手がおらぬ。平時の騎士は、民を守るのが務めだ」: "There is no foe to turn our swords on now. In peacetime, a knight's duty is to protect the people."
地の文.「あら、噂の異邦人さん。あなたの働きなら、帳簿にちゃんと付けてあるわよ」: "Oh, the stranger everyone's talking about. Your work is properly recorded in my ledger."
地の文.「……いいわ。戦で街道が閉じたら、商売あがったりだもの。損得で言えば、乗るべき話: "...Fine. If the war closes the roads, business dies. In terms of profit and loss, it's a deal worth taking."
地の文.「手を組む？ 去年の代金を踏み倒した国と？」 ミレーヌは帳簿をぱたんと閉じた。: "Join hands? With the nation that welched on last year's payment?" Mireille snapped her ledger shut.
地の文.「契約成立ね。今日からあなたは、ベルカの客将よ」 金の印章が押された契約書を渡さ: "Contract concluded. From today you're Belka's guest general." You were handed a contract stamped with a gold seal.
地の文.「今は剣より算盤の出番よ。荒事の注文が入ったら知らせるわ」: "Right now it's the abacus's turn, not the sword's. I'll let you know when a rough job comes in."
地の文.「森の外から来た人。木々が、あなたの足音を覚えています」: "Person from outside the forest. The trees remember your footsteps."
地の文.「……根は、地の下で繋がっているもの。国も、そうあるべきなのでしょう」: "...Roots are connected beneath the ground. Perhaps nations should be too."
地の文.「森に火を放った者たちと、同じ枝に止まれと？」 エルウェは静かに首を振った。: "Perch on the same branch as those who set fire to the forest?" Elwe quietly shook her head.
地の文.「若木の冠を授けます。今日からあなたは、シルヴァの森の守り手です」 枝で編んだ冠: "I bestow upon you a crown of young branches. From today you are a guardian of the Silva forest." A crown woven of branches was gently placed on your brow.
地の文.「今は森が静かです。静けさを守るのも、守り手の務めですよ」: "The forest is quiet now. Protecting the quiet is also a guardian's duty."
地の文.「おう、噂の異邦人か。腕の立つやつは嫌いじゃねえ」: "Oh, the stranger we keep hearing about. I don't mind people who can fight."
地の文.「……ふん。鉄は一本じゃ折れる。束ねりゃ折れねえ。いいだろう、乗ってやる」: "...Hmph. One iron rod snaps. A bundle won't. All right, I'm in."
地の文.「他国と手を組めだ？ うちの鉱脈を掠め取ろうとした連中とか」 ボルドは髭を揺らし: "Join hands with other nations? With the lot who tried to steal our ore veins?" Bord shook his beard and his head.
地の文.「膝をつけ。——ドルガンの鉄で打った剣だ。今日からお前は、山の戦士だ」 重い剣の: "Kneel. — A sword forged from Dorgan iron. From today you're a warrior of the mountain." The flat of a heavy sword touched your shoulder.
地の文.「今は打つ相手がいねえ。炉の火を絶やさねえのも、戦士の仕事だ」: "Nothing to strike right now. Keeping the forge fire burning is a warrior's job too."
地の文.「異邦人よ。そなたの働きは聞き及んでいる。……我が国の一派が、そなたを喚んだこと: "Stranger. I have heard of your deeds. ...And that a faction of our nation summoned you."
地の文.「……よかろう。理を尽くした言葉には、理で応えるのが学都の流儀だ」: "...Very well. To words that exhaust reason, the Academy City answers with reason."
地の文.「他国と手を組めと？ 我らの書庫を焼いた国々とか」 大導師は首を振った。: "Join hands with other nations? With the nations that burned our libraries?" The Archmage shook her head.
地の文.「杖の前に膝をつけ。——今日よりそなたは、ルーメの導師たちの護り手だ」 杖の先が: "Kneel before the staff. — From today you are a protector of the mages of Lume." The tip of the staff gently touched your shoulder.
地の文.「今は攻める理がない。学都の護り手は、書と民を守るのが務めだ」: "There is no reason to attack now. The Academy City's protectors guard books and people."
地の文.「宿場町ロシェの古い礼拝堂に、千年前に魔族を結界へ封じた騎士たちの名を刻んだ碑が: "In the old chapel of Post Town Roche there is a monument engraved with the names of the knights who sealed the demons behind the barrier a thousand years ago."
地の文.結界の綻びを抜けてきた: slipped through gaps in the barrier
地の文.「夜な夜な、{0}小鬼どもが、その碑を削りに来るという。騎士団は戦で手一杯だ。…: "They say that night after night, imps that have {0} come to deface the monument. The knights have their hands full with the war. ...Will you protect it?"
地の文.礼拝堂の裏手。月明かりの下で、碑に刻まれた名が、半ばまで削り取られていた。: Behind the chapel. Under the moonlight, the names carved on the monument had been half scraped away.
地の文.削り跡に残った爪の向きを辿ると、小鬼どもが通う抜け道が見つかった。そこで待ち伏せ: Following the direction of the claw marks, you found the path the imps use. You lie in wait there.
地の文.碑を調べているうちに、背後の茂みががさりと鳴った。: While you were examining the monument, the bushes behind you rustled.
地の文.——碑を削りに来た小鬼の頭目が、牙を剥いた！: — The imp leader who came to deface the monument bares its fangs!
地の文.倒れた頭目の腰袋から、黒い鴉の羽が一本こぼれ落ちた。: A black raven feather fell from the belt pouch of the fallen leader.
地の文.「……鴉の羽か。魔王が倒れてもなお、残党には我らの誓いが目障りと見える」: "...A raven feather. Even after the Demon Lord's fall, it seems his remnants find our oath an eyesore."
地の文.「……鴉の羽か。魔王め、千年経っても、我らの誓いが目障りと見える」: "...A raven feather. Even after a thousand years, the Demon Lord finds our oath an eyesore."
地の文.「碑を守った者に、騎士の兜を授ける。そなたの名も、いずれあの碑に刻ませよう」: "To the one who protected the monument, I grant a knight's helm. One day your name too shall be carved on that stone."
地の文.ロシェの礼拝堂の碑には、千年前の騎士たちの名の下に、新しい名がひとつ刻まれた。こ: On the monument in the chapel at Roche, beneath the names of the knights of a thousand years ago, one new name was carved. In otherworld letters that no one in this world can read.
地の文.「学都の禁書庫から、一冊が持ち出された。異界の門について記した写本だ」: "A volume has been taken from the Academy City's forbidden archive. A manuscript about the Otherworld Gate."
地の文.「持ち出したのは、イオ結界砦に詰める魔導師のひとり。門の秘密を、他国に売るつもり: "The one who took it is a mage stationed at Io Barrier Fort. He means to sell the gate's secrets to another nation. ...I would rather this not become public."
地の文.イオ結界砦の書庫塔。最上階の窓に、夜通し灯りがともっている。: The library tower of Io Barrier Fort. A light burns all night in the top-floor window.
地の文.扉に掛けられた封印の符を読み解き、音もなく解いた。: You deciphered the sealing talisman on the door and undid it without a sound.
地の文.扉の封印に触れた途端、指先から雷が走った。（HP-6）: The moment you touched the door's seal, lightning shot from your fingertips. (HP -6)
地の文.禁書庫の封印に焼かれた: burned by the forbidden archive's seal
地の文.——禁書を抱えた魔導師が、闇の術を編み上げた！: — The mage clutching the forbidden book weaves a dark spell!
地の文.取り返した写本の最後の頁には、門の開く日と、これまでに喚ばれた者たちの名が、びっ: The last page of the recovered manuscript was filled with the days the gate opens and the names of everyone summoned so far.
地の文.「……取り返してくれたか。この写本は、もう誰にも開かせぬ」: "...You recovered it. No one will ever open this manuscript again."
地の文.「礼に、これを。学都の大魔石だ。……そなたを喚んだ国が言えた義理ではないが、帰り: "Take this as thanks. A great mana stone from the Academy City. ...It's not for the nation that summoned you to say, but may it help you on your way home."
地の文.学都ルーメの禁書庫の奥で、一冊の写本が封じられた。表紙には大導師の手で、「二度と: Deep in the forbidden archive of Academy City Lume, a manuscript was sealed away. On its cover, in the Archmage's hand, were written only the words "Never to be opened again."
地の文.「商船が一隻、積荷ごと消えたの。嵐の記録はなし。おかしいでしょう？」: "A merchant ship has vanished, cargo and all. No record of a storm. Strange, isn't it?"
地の文.「港町ミラの倉庫を洗ってちょうだい。うちの番頭が絡んでいる気がするの。……身内の: "Search the warehouses in Port Town Mira. I have a feeling my head clerk is involved. ...It's a family matter, so I can't ask family."
地の文.港の倉庫街。消えたはずの商船の積荷の印が、ある倉庫の木箱に押されていた。: The warehouse district at the port. The mark of the supposedly lost ship's cargo was stamped on crates in one warehouse.
地の文.棚の奥の帳簿を読み解くと、同じ積荷が「沈没」と「売却」の両方に記されていた。番頭: Deciphering the ledger at the back of the shelves, you found the same cargo recorded as both "sunk" and "sold". In the head clerk's handwriting.
地の文.帳簿を探すのに手間取るうちに、背後で扉が閉まった。: While you fumbled looking for the ledger, the door shut behind you.
地の文.——番頭の雇った用心棒が、倉庫の奥から剣を抜いた！: — A bodyguard hired by the head clerk draws his sword in the back of the warehouse!
地の文.用心棒は、番頭から受け取った前金の袋を抱えたまま伸びていた。帳簿と一緒に、証拠は: The bodyguard lay sprawled, still clutching the bag of advance pay from the head clerk. Along with the ledger, the evidence was complete.
地の文.「……やっぱりね。積荷を売り払って、船は沈んだことにする。番頭には、利息をつけて: "...Just as I thought. Sell off the cargo and claim the ship sank. My head clerk will be paying that back with interest."
地の文.「あなたへの借りは、帳簿のいちばん上に書いておく。ベルカは、貸し借りを忘れない国: "I'll write what I owe you at the very top of my ledger. Belka is a nation that never forgets a debt."
地の文.ミレーヌの帳簿のいちばん上には、今も「異邦人に貸し一つ」と書かれたまま、消し線が: At the very top of Mireille's ledger, "One owed to the stranger" is still written, never crossed out.
地の文.「エルムの里の森で、妖精たちが狩られています。羽が、遠い国の市場で高く売れるのだ: "In the forest near Elm Hamlet, fairies are being hunted. Their wings sell for a high price in the markets of faraway lands, they say."
地の文.「弓の民が追えば、密猟者は森に火を放つでしょう。……森の外の人であるあなたに、頼: "If the bow people chase them, the poachers will set fire to the forest. ...I want to ask you, someone from outside the forest."
地の文.里外れの森に、鳥もちを塗った網が張り巡らされていた。網の中で、小さな光がいくつも: Nets smeared with birdlime were strung all through the forest outside the hamlet. Inside them, little lights were struggling.
地の文.茂みに身を伏せ、網を見回りに来た密猟者の背後を取った。: You hid in the bushes and got behind the poacher who came to check the nets.
地の文.枝を踏み折った音に、密猟者が振り返った。: At the sound of a snapping twig, the poacher turned around.
地の文.——羽を狩る密猟者が、短弓を構えた！: — The wing-hunting poacher readies a short bow!
地の文.網を切ると、小さな光がいっせいに舞い上がり、木々の梢へ消えていった。: When you cut the nets, the little lights flew up all at once and vanished into the treetops.
地の文.「……妖精たちの光が、森に戻りました。木々が、あなたの名を覚えたそうです」: "...The fairies' light has returned to the forest. The trees say they've learned your name."
地の文.「これを。森でいちばん古い四つ葉です。あなたの行く道に、木漏れ日がありますように: "Take this. The oldest four-leaf clover in the forest. May there be sunlight through the leaves on your path."
地の文.シルヴァの森では、妖精たちが異邦人の名を歌にして囀るという。エルウェはその歌を聞: In the Silva forest, they say the fairies sing the stranger's name. Every time Elwe hears that song, she smiles a little.
地の文.「鉱山町ガドの坑道が崩れた。中に鉱夫が七人、閉じ込められてる」: "A shaft in Mining Town Gad has collapsed. Seven miners are trapped inside."
地の文.「掘り進めた先で、古い石の番人を起こしちまったらしい。うちの連中じゃ近づけねえ。: "Seems they dug into an old stone guardian and woke it. My lot can't get near it. ...Please. Miners are this nation's treasure."
地の文.崩れた坑道の奥から、岩を叩く音がかすかに聞こえる。まだ生きている。: From deep within the collapsed shaft, you can faintly hear knocking on rock. They're still alive.
地の文.瓦礫を押しのけ、人ひとり通れる隙間を開けた。: You pushed aside the rubble and opened a gap big enough for one person.
地の文.瓦礫をどけるうちに、天井から石が崩れてきた。（HP-6）: As you cleared the rubble, stones fell from the ceiling. (HP -6)
地の文.坑道の落石に埋もれた: buried by a rockfall in the mine
地の文.——坑道の闇の中で、古い番人が目を開いた！: — In the darkness of the shaft, the old guardian opens its eyes!
地の文.番人が崩れ落ちた奥で、煤だらけの鉱夫たちが肩を寄せ合っていた。七人とも、生きてい: Beyond where the guardian crumbled, soot-covered miners huddled together. All seven were alive.
地の文.「七人とも生きて帰ったか！ ……がっはっは、今夜は町じゅうの酒樽を空けるぞ」: "All seven came back alive! ...Gahaha, tonight we empty every ale barrel in town."
地の文.「こいつを持ってけ。ドルガンの名匠が、三代かけて削った砥石だ」: "Take this. A whetstone that three generations of Dorgan's master smiths spent shaping."
地の文.鉱山町ガドの坑道の入口には、小さな石像が立っている。鉱夫たちは仕事の前に、その頭: At the entrance to the mine in Mining Town Gad stands a small stone statue. The miners pat its head before work. It doesn't look the least bit like the stranger, though.
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">（{0}の謁見で、{1}に報せる）</s: (Report to {1} at an audience in {0})
地の文.あなたは説いた。国同士で争っている間に、魔王軍は一国ずつ飲み込んでいく、と。: You argued that while nations fight among themselves, the Demon Army is swallowing them one at a time.
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">同盟は二国以上で意味を持つ。加盟国同士は: An alliance means something with two or more nations. Members cease fighting each other and send reinforcements to each other's fronts. With three, they might push the Demon Army back.
地の文.王子リオネルが、玉座の脇で待っている: Prince Lionel is waiting beside the throne
地の文.「これまでの働きへの礼だ」: "A reward for your service so far."
地の文.騎士として仕える。俸給が出て、戦争中の敵国を攻める命令を受けられる。ほかの国には: Serve as a knight. You receive a stipend and can receive orders to attack enemy nations at war. You can no longer serve other nations
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">【軍令】地図の拠点を右クリックすると、そ: [Campaign orders] Right-click a location on the map to give your nation's army a target. Once troops gather at the front, they attack from the neighbouring friendly site. Each sortie adds mercenaries for 60G.
地の文.戦争中の敵国の拠点を攻める。果たすと褒賞: Attack a location of an enemy nation at war. Rewarded on completion
地の文.黒い結界が道を塞いでいる。触れた指先が痺れた。今は入れそうにない。: A black barrier blocks the way. Your fingertips went numb when you touched it. You can't get in for now.
地の文.魔王軍の旗が立つ占領地。買い物も休息もできそうにない。: Occupied land under the Demon Army's flag. You won't be able to shop or rest here.
地の文.かつて{0}の地だった場所。市場は焼け落ち、宿には魔族が居座っている。買い物も休: Once the land of {0}. The market has burned down and demons have taken over the inn. You won't be able to shop or rest here.
地の文.瘴気が立ちこめる魔族の地。: A demon land thick with miasma.
地の文.黒鉄の門の前に、騎士が一騎立ちはだかる。: A lone knight stands before the black iron gate.
地の文.残るは玉座の間の守りだけだ: Only the throne room guard remains
地の文.1戦ごとに数刻（0.25日）かかる。勝つたびに兵力を3削る。0にすれば魔王軍を追: Each fight takes a few hours (0.25 days). Each win reduces troops by 3. Bring it to 0 to drive the Demon Army out
地の文.今日はもう歯が立たない: You're no match for it today
地の文.鍵開け道具があると有利。珍しい品が入っていることがある: Lockpicks help. It sometimes holds rare items

地の文.冷たい風が、下から吹き上げてくる。: A cold wind blows up from below.
地の文.壁に、先に潜った誰かの爪痕が残っている。: Claw marks of someone who went down before you remain on the wall.
地の文.松明の火が、ひとりでに細くなった。: The torch flame grew thin on its own.
地の文.足元の石段が、ところどころ濡れている。血か、水か。: The steps underfoot are wet in places. Blood, or water.
地の文.上を見ても、もう入口の光は見えない。: Looking up, you can no longer see the light of the entrance.
地の文.石段が途切れた。底のない闇の中で、巨大な眼がひとつ、ゆっくりと開いた。: The steps ended. In bottomless darkness, a single giant eye slowly opened.
地の文.広い洞の奥で、三つの首が同時にこちらを向いた。: At the back of a wide cavern, three heads turned toward you at once.
地の文.錆びた鎖を引きずる音が、闇の奥から近づいてくる。: The sound of rusty chains being dragged draws near from the depths of the darkness.
地の文.主が崩れ落ちると、奈落の底に、長いあいだ溜め込まれてきた品が見えた。: When the lord crumbled, the goods hoarded at the bottom of the abyss for ages came into view.
地の文.闇の中心で、黒い心臓がまだ脈打っていた。: At the centre of the darkness, a black heart was still beating.
地の文.足元で、さらに深いところから、地鳴りが響いた。: Beneath your feet, a rumble echoed from somewhere even deeper.
地の文.石段の踊り場に、この層を縄張りにする主がいる。: On the landing of the steps is the lord who claims this floor as its territory.
地の文.主の寝床に、先に潜った者たちの荷が散らばっていた。: In the lord's lair lay the belongings of those who came down before.
地の文.魔物の巣の奥に、喰い残しの荷が転がっていた。: At the back of a monster's nest lay leftover belongings.
地の文.崩れた祭壇に、誰かの荷が残っていた。: Someone's belongings remained on a crumbled altar.
地の文.魔物の気配がない。息を整えて、先を急いだ。: No sign of monsters. You caught your breath and pressed on.
地の文.静かな層だ。足音だけが、闇に吸い込まれていく。: A quiet floor. Only your footsteps are swallowed by the dark.
地の文.報酬は後でいい。今日は、ただ働きだ: Pay me later. Today I work for free
地の文.聖騎士の務めです。……いいえ、友の務めです: It is a paladin's duty. ...No, a friend's duty
地の文.ひとりで面白いことしようなんて、ずるいぞ: Doing something fun all by yourself? No fair
地の文.異界の存在……研究させてもらうよ。生きて帰れたらね: An otherworld being... let me study it. If we make it back alive
地の文.獲物は大きいほうがいい。そうだろう？: The bigger the prey, the better. Right?
地の文.……命じられて来たのではない。我が意志で、ここに立つ: ...No one commanded me here. I stand here by my own will
地の文.……思い出せないけれど、ここに来なければいけない気がした: ...I can't remember, but I felt I had to come here
地の文.アルデンの騎士として——いや、友として来た: I've come as a knight of Arden — no, as a friend
地の文.父の世界も、あなたの世界も、喰わせはしません: I won't let it devour my father's world, or yours
地の文.門は砕け、ただの瓦礫になっている。瓦礫の脇に、名を刻んだ小さな石碑が建っている。: The gate has shattered into mere rubble. Beside the rubble stands a small stone monument engraved with names.
地の文.門の跡から、黒い霧が絶え間なく溢れている。石の門は内側から押し広げられ、その奥で: Black mist pours endlessly from the remains of the gate. The stone gate is being pushed open from within, and beyond it countless pale hands are writhing.
地の文.{0}人が駆けつけてくれそうだ（好感度の高い冒険者）: {0} people look likely to come to your aid (adventurers with high affection)
地の文.駆けつける者はいなさそうだ: No one looks likely to come
地の文.低く唸って、門へ歩み寄る: growling low, you approach the gate
地の文.剣を抜いて、門へ歩み寄る: drawing your sword, you approach the gate
地の文.振り返っても、誰もいない。風の音だけだ。: You turn around, but no one is there. Only the sound of the wind.
地の文.隣の仲間が、黙って剣を構えた。: The companion beside you silently readied their sword.
地の文.駆けつけた者の数だけ、: For each who came to help,
地の文.が、門の向こうから身を乗り出した！: leans out from beyond the gate!
地の文.門を喰らうものは、門の奥へ引きずり込まれるように崩れていった。黒い霧が晴れると、: The Gate Eater crumbled as if being dragged back into the gate. When the black mist cleared, the stone gate silently shattered into mere rubble.
地の文.駆けつけた者たちは、ひとりずつ、あなたの肩を叩いて帰っていった。: The ones who came to help each clapped you on the shoulder and went home.
地の文.砕けた門の瓦礫に、朝の光が差してきた。もう、光の紋様が地を走ることはない。: Morning light fell on the rubble of the shattered gate. No pattern of light will ever spread across the ground again.
地の文.世界樹の根元: the roots of the World Tree
地の文.世界樹の根元で、木漏れ日がひとつ、ふわりと浮き上がった。よく見ると、羽の生えた小: At the roots of the World Tree, a spot of sunlight floated gently upward. Looking closely, it has the shape of a tiny winged person.
地の文.ほかの輪をまだ見つけていない: You haven't found any other rings yet
地の文.輪の中に立って目を閉じると、草の匂いと笑い声が渦を巻いた。: When you stood in the ring and closed your eyes, the scent of grass and laughter swirled around you.
地の文.目を開けると、{0}に立っていた。日はずいぶん傾いている。: When you opened your eyes, you were standing at {0}. The sun has sunk quite low.
地の文.竜の巣は、焼け焦げた岩と、巨大な骨だけになっている。: The dragon's lair is nothing but scorched rock and giant bones.
地の文.巣の奥で、古竜が丸くなって眠っている。笛の音に、片目だけを開けて応えた。: Deep in the lair, the ancient dragon sleeps curled up. At the sound of the flute, it opened one eye in answer.
地の文.山肌をえぐった巨大な洞の奥で、溶けた岩のような鱗が上下している。熱い風が、寝息に: Deep in a huge cavern gouged out of the mountainside, scales like molten rock rise and fall. Hot wind gusts in time with its breathing.
地の文.宝石を二つ、竜の鼻先に置いた。: You placed two gems before the dragon's nose.
地の文.金貨の袋を逆さにして、竜の鼻先に黄金を積み上げた。溶岩の光が、金貨に跳ね返る。: You upended your bag of coins and piled gold before the dragon's nose. The glow of the lava glinted off the coins.
地の文.古竜は最後に、空へ向かって長く吼えた。その声が途切れると、山じゅうの溶岩の光が、: At the end, the ancient dragon let out a long roar to the sky. When its voice faded, the glow of the lava across the mountain went out, one by one.
地の文.光る欠片と石碑の前に、岩の巨人が座している。: Before a glowing fragment and a stone tablet sits a giant of rock.
地の文.主の気配がする。: You sense the presence of a lord.
地の文.息を殺して巨人の背後に回り、欠片を掴んだ。: Holding your breath, you circled behind the giant and grabbed the fragment.
地の文.小石を蹴ってしまった。巨人の目が光る。: You kicked a pebble. The giant's eyes lit up.
地の文.奥に宝箱がある。: There's a treasure chest at the back.
地の文.さらに奥の祭壇に、黄金に輝く果実が供えられている。: On the altar further in, a fruit gleaming gold has been offered.
地の文.祭壇の台座に、文字の刻まれた石が嵌め込まれている。: A stone carved with letters is set into the altar's pedestal.
地の文.箱の底に、黄金に輝く果実が転がっていた。: A fruit gleaming gold was rolling at the bottom of the chest.
地の文.迷宮が低く鳴動している。長居は無用だ。: The labyrinth is rumbling low. Best not to linger.
地の文.広間に出た。この階層を縄張りにする強敵がいる。: You came out into a hall. A powerful foe claims this level as its territory.
地の文.広間の奥に、先人が残した荷があった。: At the back of the hall lay belongings left by those who came before.
地の文.蓋の隙間から、ねっとりとした涎が垂れている。——<b>ミミックだ。</b>: Sticky drool is dripping from the gap in the lid. — A mimic.
地の文.ただの箱のようだ。: It seems to be an ordinary chest.
地の文.鍵穴に触れた瞬間、箱がばくりと口を開けた！: The moment you touched the keyhole, the chest gaped open!
地の文.罠だ！ 矢が肩をかすめた。（HP-{0}）: A trap! An arrow grazed your shoulder. (HP -{0})
地の文.足元の床が沈んだ——罠だ。: The floor sank beneath your feet — a trap.
地の文.とっさに飛びのいた。: You leapt aside just in time.
地の文.落石を受けた。（HP-{0}）: You were hit by falling rocks. (HP -{0})
地の文.壁に鉱脈が露出している。: A vein of ore is exposed in the wall.
地の文.素手ではどうにもならない。つるはしがあれば……: You can't do anything bare-handed. If only you had a pickaxe...
地の文.湿った壁際に薬草が群生している。: Herbs grow in clusters along the damp wall.
地の文.澄んだ湧き水があった。喉を潤し、一息つく。（HP+{0}）: There was a clear spring. You wet your throat and caught your breath. (HP +{0})
地の文.街道脇の崩れた石小屋。風雨にさらされた革の包みに、紙の束が挟まっていた。: A collapsed stone hut by the road. A bundle of papers was tucked into a weather-beaten leather wrap.
地の文.喚ばれて十日。教団の連中は、僕を見るなり「外れだ」と言って遺跡に放り出した。言葉: Ten days since I was summoned. The cultists took one look at me, said "a dud", and threw me out of the ruins. Strangely, I can understand their language. Because I understand, it hurt all the more.
地の文.遺跡で拾った剣は錆びていた。柄に自分の名前を刻んでおく。次に拾う誰かが、ひとりき: The sword I picked up in the ruins was rusty. I'll carve my name on the hilt. So that whoever picks it up next won't think they're all alone.
地の文.倒れた道標の根元に、油紙にくるんだ紙が埋もれていた。あの手記と同じ筆跡だ。: At the foot of a fallen signpost, papers wrapped in oiled paper lay buried. The same handwriting as that journal.
地の文.宿場の親父に、門の話を聞いた。百日目に開く。帰れる。帰れるはずだ。……ただ、門の: I heard about the gate from the innkeeper at the post town. It opens on the hundredth day. I can go home. I should be able to go home. ...But they say a giant of light stands before the gate.
地の文.この世界で、はじめて友達ができた。帰りたい理由と、帰りたくない理由が、同じくらい: I made my first friend in this world. The reasons I want to go home and the reasons I don't are starting to weigh about the same.
地の文.古い野営の跡。焚き火の石の下に、最後の頁が挟まれていた。: An old campsite. The last page was tucked under the campfire stones.
地の文.百日目は、雨だった。僕は門へ行かなかった。後悔はしていない、と書いておく。: On the hundredth day, it rained. I didn't go to the gate. I'll write that I have no regrets.
地の文.いつかまた誰かが喚ばれたら、あの遺跡の石柱の、北の根元を掘ってほしい。僕が持って: If someone is ever summoned again, I want them to dig at the north foot of the stone pillar in those ruins. I buried one of the things I had there.
地の文.鞄の剣の柄を見る。刻まれた見知らぬ文字は——この手記の筆跡と、同じ形をしていた。: You look at the hilt of the sword in your bag. The unfamiliar letters carved there — were the same shape as the handwriting in this journal.
地の文.。召喚の遺跡で、何かが見つかりそうだ: . Something may be found at the Summoning Ruins
地の文.崖崩れの跡に、古い工房の壁が覗いている。瓦礫の間から、人の形をした金属の腕が突き: The wall of an old workshop peeks out from a landslide. From between the rubble jutted a human-shaped metal arm.
地の文.掘り返すと、胸の装甲の奥で、緑の石がかすかに脈打っている。この人形は、まだ死んで: When you dug it out, deep behind the chest armor, a green stone was faintly pulsing. This automaton isn't dead yet.
地の文.振り返ると、緑の光が一度だけ瞬いた気がした。: Looking back, you thought the green light blinked just once.
地の文.瓦礫が崩れ、腕を挟まれた。: The rubble collapsed and pinned your arm.
地の文.継ぎ目に指をかけた途端、火花が散った。: The moment you hooked a finger into the seam, sparks flew.
地の文.人形は動かないまま、また瓦礫に埋もれてしまった。この道を通れば、また会えるかもし: The automaton, still motionless, was buried in rubble again. If you take this road, you may meet it again.
地の文.かちりと音がして、手のひらほどの緑の結晶が外れた。温かい。耳を澄ますと、規則正し: With a click, a palm-sized green crystal came loose. It's warm. Listening closely, you can hear a steady ticking.
地の文.<span class=\"ok\">鞄に置くと3×5の枠ができる。頭・腕・胴・: Placed in your bag, it creates a 3×5 frame. Fill the head, arm, torso and leg slots with items, and it looks like you can assemble the automaton's body.
地の文.街道の窪みに、荷馬車が車輪を取られて傾いている。商人が汗だくで押しているが、びく: A cart has a wheel stuck in a rut on the road and is leaning over. A merchant is pushing, drenched in sweat, but it won't budge.
地の文.教科書で見た図そのままに、丸太を車輪の下へ差し込んだ。荷車はあっけなく窪みを抜け: Just like the diagram in your textbook, you wedged a log under the wheel. The cart came out of the rut with no trouble.
地の文.丸太を車輪の下へ差し込んで体重をかけると、荷車はあっけなく窪みを抜けた。: When you wedged a log under the wheel and put your weight on it, the cart came out of the rut with no trouble.
地の文.掛け声とともに押し上げると、荷車はぐらりと揺れて窪みを抜けた。: With a heave you pushed it up, and the cart lurched out of the rut.
地の文.踏ん張った拍子に、腰を痛めた。: You strained so hard you hurt your back.
地の文.商人は首をかしげた。「てこ……？」 言葉は通じても、話は通じなかった。: The merchant tilted his head. "A lever...?" The words got through, but the idea didn't.
地の文.谷に架かった吊り橋の板が、ところどころ抜け落ちている。迂回すれば丸一日の遠回りだ: The planks of the rope bridge over the valley are missing in places. Going around would mean a full day's detour.
地の文.谷沿いの道を延々と歩いた。腹が鳴る。: You walked on and on along the valley road. Your stomach growls.
地の文.綱を握りしめ、一歩ずつ渡りきった。: Gripping the ropes, you made it across one step at a time.
地の文.向こう岸の岩棚に、鳥の巣があった。中で何かが光っている。: On a rock ledge on the far side was a bird's nest. Something is glinting inside.
地の文.板が割れ、片足が宙を踏んだ。綱にしがみついて這い上がった。: A plank broke and one foot stepped into thin air. You clung to the rope and climbed back up.
地の文.急に霧が濃くなった。道が二股に分かれているが、道標の文字は苔で読めない。: The fog suddenly thickened. The road forks, but the signpost's letters are covered in moss.
地の文.苔の付き方と、遠くの水音を頼りに道を選んだ。霧の晴れ間に、薬草の群生が見えた。: You chose a path by the way the moss grew and the sound of distant water. Through a break in the fog, you spotted a cluster of herbs.
地の文.同じ岩の前を三度通った。ようやく霧を抜けたときには、すっかり腹が減っていた。（満: You passed the same rock three times. By the time you finally got out of the fog, you were starving. (Food -1)
地の文.木陰で、リュートを抱えた吟遊詩人が休んでいる。「旅の方、一曲いかが？ 歌えるなら: A bard holding a lute is resting in the shade. "Traveller, care for a song? If you can sing, why not join in?"
地の文.あなたが歌い出すと、詩人は目を丸くし、慌てて伴奏を合わせた。通りがかりの旅人が足: When you started to sing, the bard's eyes went wide and he hurried to match the accompaniment. Passing travellers stopped and a crowd formed.
地の文.二人の声が重なると、通りがかりの旅人が足を止めた。: When your two voices joined, passing travellers stopped.
地の文.最初の一節で声が裏返った。詩人は優しく笑って、そっとリュートを鳴らし直した。: Your voice cracked on the very first line. The bard smiled kindly and quietly started the lute again.
地の文.街道の両脇の茂みが、風もないのに揺れた気がする。: The bushes on both sides of the road seemed to sway, though there's no wind.
地の文.茂みの陰に、刃物の光が見えた。待ち伏せだ——まだ、こちらは気づかれていない。: In the shadow of the bushes you saw the glint of a blade. An ambush — and they haven't noticed you yet.
地の文.息を殺して脇道を抜けた。: Holding your breath, you slipped through a side path.
地の文.連中の荷から、盗品らしき包みが出てきた。: A package that looked like stolen goods turned up in their belongings.
地の文.「金目のものを置いていけ！」 気づいたときには囲まれていた。: "Leave your valuables!" By the time you noticed, you were surrounded.
地の文.道端で、旅装束の老人がうずくまっている。足を挫いたらしい。: An old man in travelling clothes is crouched by the road. He seems to have twisted his ankle.
地の文.（看護師の腕の見せどころ）: (a chance for the Nurse to shine)
地の文.振り返ると、老人はまだそこに座っていた。: Looking back, the old man was still sitting there.
地の文.手際よく足首を固定すると、老人は立ち上がって何度も頭を下げた。: You deftly splinted his ankle, and the old man stood up and bowed again and again.
地の文.包帯の巻き方がまずかった。老人は苦笑いしながら、杖を頼りに自分で歩き出した。: You wrapped the bandage badly. The old man smiled wryly and started walking on his own, leaning on his cane.
地の文.街道脇の草むらに、茸が輪になって生えている。輪の中から、くすくすと小さな笑い声が: In the grass by the road, mushrooms grow in a ring. Small giggles come from inside the ring.
地の文.茸は、よく効く薬の材料だった。: The mushrooms were the makings of a potent medicine.
地の文.一口かじったら、舌が痺れて目が回った。毒茸だ。: You took a bite and your tongue went numb and your head spun. A poisonous mushroom.
地の文.ロバに荷を積んだ行商人が、道端に敷物を広げている。「お客さん、街じゃ手に入らない: A peddler with a donkey loaded with goods has spread a mat by the road. "Customer, I have goods you can't get in town."
地の文.辻に、苔むした小さな祠がある。供え物の小銭と、干からびた果物が置かれている。: At a crossroads there is a small moss-covered shrine. Coins and shrivelled fruit have been left as offerings.
地の文.風が吹いて、供えた小銭がちりんと鳴った。: The wind blew, and the coins you offered jingled.
地の文.手を伸ばした瞬間、祠から突風が吹いて、石段から転げ落ちた。: The moment you reached out, a gust blew from the shrine and you tumbled down the stone steps.
地の文.日が落ちても宿場が見えない。霧の中に、黒い外套の人影が立っていた。「こんな夜更け: The sun has set and the post town is still not in sight. In the fog stood a figure in a black cloak. "All alone at this late hour?" A pale face smiled broadly.
地の文.聖水が外套にかかると、男は悲鳴を上げて霧に溶けた。足元に、牙が一本落ちている。: When the holy water splashed his cloak, the man screamed and melted into the fog. A single fang lay at your feet.
地の文.月明かりの下なのに、男の足元には影がない——吸血鬼だ。: Though it's under the moonlight, the man casts no shadow — a vampire.
地の文.気を許した瞬間、首筋に冷たい牙が触れた。: The moment you let your guard down, cold fangs touched your neck.
地の文.街道に丸太の柵が渡され、槍を持った兵が旅人を一人ずつ改めている。戦の最中で、通行: A log barrier is stretched across the road, and soldiers with spears are checking travellers one by one. With the war on, they seem to be collecting a toll.
地の文.兵は硬貨を数えもせずに懐へ入れ、顎で先を示した。: The soldier pocketed the coins without counting them and jerked his chin onward.
地の文.「異邦人？ 噂のやつか。……通れ。面倒はごめんだ」 兵は気味悪そうに柵を上げた。: "A stranger? The one everyone's talking about? ...Go on. I don't want trouble." The soldier raised the barrier, looking uneasy.
地の文.「怪しいやつだ」 結局、色をつけて{0}G払わされた。: "Suspicious, you are." In the end you had to pay extra: {0}G.
地の文.枝を踏まないよう、柵の脇の森を抜けた。藪の中に、誰かが落とした薬草の包みがあった: Careful not to step on twigs, you slipped through the woods beside the barrier. In the thicket was a packet of herbs someone had dropped.
地の文.「そこの者、止まれ！」 見つかって、藪の中を散々追い回された。: "You there, halt!" You were spotted and chased all through the thicket.
地の文.にわか雨だ。崖の下の浅い洞穴に駆け込むと、奥に先客の気配がある。: A sudden shower. You ran into a shallow cave beneath a cliff, and sensed someone already deeper inside.
地の文.焚き火のそばで、薬箱を背負った旅の薬師が手を振った。「ひどい雨だね。あたってきな: By a campfire, a travelling apothecary with a medicine chest on her back waved. "Awful rain, isn't it. Come warm yourself."
地の文.暗がりで、{0}が丸くなって眠っていた。寝息のたびに、生臭い風が来る。: In the darkness, a {0} was curled up asleep. With every breath came a gust of rank air.
地の文.ずぶ濡れで歩き続けた。体が冷えて、腹が鳴る。（満腹-1）: You kept walking, soaked to the skin. You're chilled and your stomach growls. (Food -1)
地の文.雨は一刻ほどで上がった。そっと洞穴を出ると、獣はまだ寝息を立てていた。: The rain stopped after an hour or so. When you quietly left the cave, the beast was still breathing in its sleep.
地の文.出がけに、獣が溜め込んでいた木の実の山を少し分けてもらった。: On your way out, you helped yourself to a little of the pile of nuts the beast had hoarded.
地の文.小石を蹴ってしまった。獣の目が、闇の中で光った。: You kicked a pebble. The beast's eyes shone in the darkness.
地の文.道端に、刺繍の入った革の財布が落ちている。ずしりと重い。少し先を、杖をついた老婆: An embroidered leather purse lies by the road. It's heavy. A little ahead, an old woman with a cane is walking slowly.
地の文.財布の中身は、銅貨に見せかけた鉄くずだった。「拾ったな？ それは俺たちの財布だ」: The purse held scrap iron disguised as copper coins. "Picked it up, did ya? That's our purse." Men came out of the bushes.
地の文.振り返ると、老婆が地面を探し回っていた。……胸の奥が、少しだけ重い。: Looking back, the old woman was searching the ground. ...Your heart feels a little heavy.
地の文.茂みの奥から、甲高い鳴き声がする。狩人の罠に、銀色の毛並みの狐が足を挟まれていた: A shrill cry comes from deep in the bushes. A silver-furred fox has its leg caught in a hunter's trap.
地の文.狩人には悪いが、毛皮はいただいていく。: Sorry to the hunter, but you'll be taking the pelt.
地の文.暴れる狐に手を噛まれた。それでも、罠はどうにか外れた。: The struggling fox bit your hand. Still, you managed to free it from the trap.
地の文.狐は一度も振り返らずに、森へ消えた。: The fox vanished into the forest without looking back once.
地の文.罠を外すと、狐は少し離れたところで足を止め、こちらをじっと見た。: When you freed it from the trap, the fox stopped a little way off and stared at you.
地の文.しばらくして、狐が何かをくわえて戻ってきた。足元に置くと、今度こそ森へ消えた。: After a while, the fox came back carrying something in its mouth. It set it at your feet, and this time vanished into the forest for good.
地の文.街道脇の草むらに、半ば埋もれた石碑が立っている。風化した古い文字が、びっしりと刻: In the grass by the road stands a half-buried stone tablet. It's densely carved with weathered ancient letters.
地の文.苔を払うと、石碑は少しだけ誇らしげに見えた。: When you brushed off the moss, the tablet looked just a little proud.
地の文.文字は風化が進みすぎていた。目が疲れただけだった。: The letters were too weathered. All you got was tired eyes.
地の文.古い暦の碑だった。「喚ばれし者の門は、百の昼と百の夜ののちに開く」——そう読める: It was an ancient calendar stone. "The gate of the summoned opens after a hundred days and a hundred nights" — so it seems to read.
地の文.夜、尾を引く流れ星が、丘の向こうに落ちた。地面がかすかに揺れた。: At night, a shooting star with a long tail fell beyond the hill. The ground shook faintly.
地の文.焦げた草の窪みの底で、まだ温かい石が光っていた。: At the bottom of a hollow of scorched grass, a still-warm stone was glowing.
地の文.暗い斜面で足を滑らせた。結局、何も見つからなかった。: You slipped on the dark slope. In the end, you found nothing.
地の文.指揮を失った軍勢は散り散りになった。: Without its commander, the army scattered.
地の文.🚩 {0}の軍勢（兵力{1}）と鉢合わせた。斥候がこちらに向かってくる。: 🚩 You ran into an army of {0} (troops {1}). Scouts are heading your way.
地の文.軍勢は隊列を立て直すため、足を止めた。（残り兵力{0}・半日のあいだ動かない）: The army halted to re-form its ranks. ({0} troops left; won't move for half a day)
地の文.が裏切り者に剣を向けた！: turns its sword on the traitor!
地の文.<span class=\"ng\">拠点は魔王軍の手に落ちた。市場も宿も、もう: The location has fallen to the Demon Army. The market and inn can no longer be used.
地の文.{0} 街道の向こうから、<b>{1}</b>が歩いてくる。: {0} From down the road, {1} is walking toward you.
地の文.早馬が街道を駆け抜けていく。掲げた旗は<b style=\"color:{0}\: A fast rider gallops down the road. The banner held high is that of {1}.
地の文.黒鉄の砦から瘴気が引いていく。魔王軍との長い戦は、こうして終わった。: The miasma recedes from the black iron forts. And so the long war with the Demon Army ended.
地の文.仕える国の旗が、魔王の玉座に立ったのだ。あなたの剣も、その勝利の一端を担っている: The flag of the nation you serve stands at the Demon Lord's throne. Your sword played its part in that victory.
地の文.あなたが説いて回った同盟が、ついに魔王を討った。剣を交えずとも、この勝利はあなた: The alliance you went around preaching has finally slain the Demon Lord. Even without crossing swords, this victory is yours too.
地の文.魔王の傍らに立つはずだった道は、ここで途絶えた。: The path that would have put you at the Demon Lord's side ends here.
地の文.あなたの知らないところで、世界は自分の力で決着をつけた。: Somewhere you didn't see, the world settled things by its own strength.
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">（魔王軍の残党はまだ各地の砦に残っている: (Remnants of the Demon Army still hold forts here and there. You can continue your journey)
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">（{0}の都では、戦勝の祝宴が開かれると: (A victory feast is to be held in the capital of {0}. Join the victory parade now, or continue your journey? Even if you travel on, you can be invited to the feast in any human capital at any time)
地の文.街道の先で荷車が横倒しになっている。行商人が、棍棒を持った追い剥ぎに囲まれていた: Ahead on the road a cart has overturned. A peddler is surrounded by highwaymen with clubs. "S-someone! Anyone!"
地の文.「助かった……！ わしはハンス、{0}まで荷を運ぶ途中でな。すまんが、そこまで一: "Saved...! I'm Hans, on my way to {0} with goods. Sorry, but would you come with me that far? I'll make it worth your while."
地の文.「着いた着いた。約束の礼だ。金はないが、商売人の知恵をひとつ教えよう」: "Here we are, here we are. Your promised thanks. I've no money, but I'll teach you a bit of a trader's wisdom."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>錆びた剣の上に砥石を重ねて</b>みな。相性のいい品同士は光っ: "In your bag, try stacking a whetstone on top of a rusty sword. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. In this world, that's how you grow your gear."
地の文.「おう、あんたか。商いは順調だ。ほれ、取っとけ」: "Oh, it's you. Business is going well. Here, take this."
地の文.「仕入れの帰りでな。また寄ってくれ」: "Just back from buying stock. Come again."
地の文.ハンスの店は焼け落ち、看板だけが転がっていた。あの人は、もういない。: Hans's shop had burned down; only the signboard lay on the ground. He is gone.
地の文.悲鳴が聞こえた。薬草籠を抱えた少女が、狼に追い詰められている。: You heard a scream. A girl clutching a basket of herbs is cornered by wolves.
地の文.「ありがとう……！ あたしリタ。{0}のおばさんの所へ薬草を届ける途中だったの。: "Thank you...! I'm Rita. I was taking herbs to my aunt in {0}. Won't you come with me?"
地の文.「着いた！ おばさんの家、あそこ。……そうだ、お礼にいいこと教えてあげる」: "We're here! That's my aunt's house. ...Oh, I'll tell you something good as thanks."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>薬草の上に薬草を重ねて</b>みて。相性のいい品は光って、ひと: "In your bag, try stacking an herb on top of an herb. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. Two herbs make a potion."
地の文.「来てくれたんだ！ お弁当作ったの。持ってって」: "You came! I made you a bento. Take it."
地の文.「おばさんの手伝い中。また明日も来てね」: "I'm helping my aunt. Come again tomorrow."
地の文.リタのおばさんの家は、扉が破られたままになっていた。あの子は、もういない。: The door of Rita's aunt's house was left broken in. The girl is gone.
地の文.紋章入りの馬車が止まり、御者が倒れている。槍を構えた兵が馬車の扉に手を掛けていた: A crested carriage has stopped and the coachman lies collapsed. A soldier with a spear has his hand on the carriage door. An enemy scout.
地の文.「礼を言う、旅の者。わしはオルド。{0}へ戻る途中で待ち伏せに遭った。御者の代わ: "My thanks, traveller. I am Ord. I was ambushed on my way back to {0}. Would you escort me to the fort in place of my coachman?"
地の文.「無事に着いた。そなたのおかげだ。……手ぶらで帰すわけにはいかんな」: "We arrived safely. All thanks to you. ...I can't send you off empty-handed."
地の文.「武具庫の余りだが、持っていけ。鞄の中で、<b>短剣の上に短剣を重ねる</b>の: "Spares from my armory, but take them. In your bag, stack a dagger on top of a dagger. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. Two blades make twin blades."
地の文.「よく来た。旅費の足しにせよ。若い者は遠慮をするな」: "Welcome. Put this toward your travel costs. Young people shouldn't hold back."
地の文.「戦況は芳しくない。そなたも気をつけよ」: "The war goes poorly. You take care as well."
地の文.オルド卿の屋敷には魔王軍の旗が立っていた。あの人は、もういない。: The Demon Army's flag flew over Lord Ord's mansion. He is gone.
地の文.ガシャン、と金属の音がした。街道脇の水たまりで、鎧姿の少年がスライムともみ合って: Clang—metal on metal. In a puddle by the road, a boy in armor is wrestling with a slime. His sword has been swallowed by its body; only the hilt sticks out. "G-give it back! That's my father's...!"
地の文.「た、助かりました……！ 僕はフェリクス、{0}の見習い騎士です。伝令の帰りに、: "Th-thank you...! I'm Felix, a squire at {0}. I took a shortcut on my way back from a message run, and... Um, could you come with me to the fort? If I go back alone, something might take my sword again."
地の文.「着きました！ ……隊長には、スライムの件は内緒にしてください。そうだ、お礼に騎: "We made it! ...Please don't tell the captain about the slime. Oh—as thanks, let me share one of the order's teachings."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>木の盾の上に鉄鉱石を重ねて</b>みてください。相性のいい品は: "In your bag, try stacking iron ore on top of a wooden shield. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. Work iron into it and the wooden shield becomes an iron one. ...Or so the manual says."
地の文.「あっ、あなたは！ 兵舎の朝のパンです。……ひとつ多くもらってきました。内緒です: "Oh, it's you! Here's bread from the barracks breakfast. ...I took one extra. Don't tell anyone."
地の文.「今日は剣を取られずに済みました。毎日が修行です」: "Nobody took my sword today. Every day is training."
地の文.砦の兵舎は焼け落ち、壁に掛かっていた小さな盾だけが残っていた。あの少年は、もうい: The fort's barracks have burned down; only a small shield that hung on the wall remains. The boy is gone.
地の文.くすくすと笑う声がする。弓を抱えた少年が、同じ木の周りをぐるぐると回っていた。そ: You hear giggling. A boy clutching a bow is walking circles around the same tree, while a tiny light dances merrily above his head. A forest pixie is leading him astray.
地の文.「……あれ？ 道が見える。ずっと同じところを歩いてたのか、おれ。……おれはティオ: "...Huh? I can see the path. Was I walking in the same spot this whole time? ...I'm Tio, an apprentice hunter at {0}. Hey, come with me to the fort, will you? I can't take getting lost like that again."
地の文.「着いた！ ……親方には、妖精の話はするなよ。笑われるから。そのかわり、いいこと: "We're here! ...Don't tell the master about the pixie. He'll laugh at me. In return, I'll teach you something good."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>木の枝の上に木の枝を重ねて</b>みな。相性のいい品は光って、: "In your bag, try stacking a branch on top of a branch. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. Two straight branches make arrows. In the forest, you don't pick up arrows—you make them."
地の文.「よう！ 今日は鹿が獲れたんだ。干し肉、持ってけよ」: "Hey! I got a deer today. Take some jerky."
地の文.見張り台の下の猟師小屋は、空っぽだった。壁に、子ども用の小さな弓が掛かったままに: The hunters' hut below the watchtower is empty. A small child's bow still hangs on the wall. The boy is gone.
地の文.崩れかけた古い坑道の入口から、怒鳴り声が聞こえる。カンテラを振り回した女が、大コ: Shouting comes from the mouth of a crumbling old mine. A woman swinging a lantern is being chased by a giant bat. "Shoo, shoo! Keep your claws off my ore!"
地の文.「ふう……助かったよ。あたしはヘルガ。{0}に、掘った鉱石を納めに行くところさ。: "Phew... thanks. I'm Helga. I'm on my way to deliver the ore I dug to {0}. Mind keeping me company that far? This sack is heavy."
地の文.「着いた着いた。納めの分も無事だ。……礼に、鉱夫の知恵をひとつ教えてやろう」: "Here we are. The delivery's safe too. ...As thanks, let me teach you a bit of miner's wisdom."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>木の枝の上に鉄鉱石を重ねて</b>ごらん。相性のいい品は光って: "In your bag, try stacking iron ore on top of a branch. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. That gives you a pickaxe. A digger makes her own tools."
地の文.「おや、来たね。今日はいい筋に当たったんだ。ひとつ持っておいき」: "Oh, you came. I hit a good vein today. Take one with you."
地の文.「山はね、掘れば掘っただけ応えてくれる。人間よりよっぽど正直さ」: "The mountain gives back exactly as much as you dig. Far more honest than people."
地の文.坑道の入口は崩され、ヘルガのカンテラだけが転がっていた。あの人は、もういない。: The mine entrance has been caved in; only Helga's lantern lies on the ground. She is gone.
地の文.湖のほとりに、小舟が引き上げられている。網を抱えた老人が、ゴブリンに魚籠を引った: A small boat has been pulled up on the lakeshore. An old man clutching a net is about to have his fish basket snatched by a goblin. "Stop that! Those are for the checkpoint!"
地の文.「やれやれ、助かったわい。わしはロッコ、この湖で網を打って五十年じゃ。獲れた魚を: "Well now, you saved me. I'm Rocco—I've cast my nets on this lake for fifty years. I'm off to sell my catch at {0}. Sorry to ask, but would you come along that far?"
地の文.「着いたわい。関所の連中は、湖の魚に目がなくてな。……礼に、漁師の知恵をひとつ」: "Here we are. The checkpoint folk can't get enough of lake fish. ...As thanks, a bit of fisherman's wisdom."
地の文.「鞄の中で、<b>木の枝の上にロープを重ねて</b>みなされ。相性のいい品は光っ: "In your bag, try stacking a rope on top of a branch. Items that suit each other glow and fuse into one. That makes a fishing rod. No net? With one rod, you'll never starve."
地の文.「おう、来たか。今朝の湖は機嫌がよくてな。一尾持っていきなされ」: "Ah, you came. The lake was in a good mood this morning. Take a fish."
地の文.「賢者さまも、ときどき湖に糸を垂れに来なさる。わしより下手じゃがの」: "The sage comes to drop a line in the lake now and then. Worse at it than me, mind you."
地の文.関所の市場に、ロッコの魚を並べる台はもうなかった。あの人は、もういない。: Rocco's fish stall is no longer at the checkpoint market. He is gone.
地の文.あなたは目を伏せて、道の端を通り過ぎた。背後の声は、やがて聞こえなくなった。: You lowered your eyes and passed along the edge of the road. Before long the voices behind you could no longer be heard.
地の文.{0}には魔王軍の旗が立っていた。{1}は青ざめ、礼を言って別の道へ去っていった: The Demon Army's flag was flying over {0}. {1} went pale, thanked you, and left by another road.
地の文.<span class=\"dim\">{0}は{1}に住んでいる。立ち寄ると、: {0} lives in {1}. Drop by and they sometimes give you something.
地の文.来なすったか。干し肉を炙っておいたんじゃ。持っていきなされ: There you are. I've roasted some jerky. Take it with you
地の文.羊は今日も元気じゃ。わしもな: The sheep are lively today. So am I
地の文.旅の話を聞かせてくれんか。……いや、また今度でええ: Won't you tell me about your travels? ...No, another time is fine
地の文.旅の人かね。わしはゴロ、この村で羊を飼って四十年じゃ。……ちょうどええ、頼みを聞: A traveller, eh? I'm Goro, been keeping sheep in this village for forty years. ...Just in time — would you hear a request of mine?
地の文.夜な夜な羊を狙う獣がおってな。追い払ってくれんか: There's a beast that goes after the sheep night after night. Would you drive it off?
地の文.おお、これで羊どもも眠れる。若い頃のわしなら杖一本で……いや、嘘じゃ: Oh, now the sheep can sleep. In my younger days I'd have done it with just a staff... no, that's a lie
地の文.冬が来る前に外套を繕いたい。毛皮を一枚、分けてもらえんか: I want to mend my cloak before winter comes. Could you spare me a pelt?
地の文.暖かそうじゃ。礼に、干し肉を持っていきなされ: Looks warm. Take some jerky as thanks
地の文.町に出た倅に、手紙を書いた。字は村の祈り手さまに習ったんじゃ。届けてくれるかの: I wrote a letter to my son who went off to town. I learned my letters from the village prayer keeper. Would you deliver it?
地の文.「親父から？ ……あの頑固者が、手紙なんて」若い兵士は、手紙を胸にしまった。: "From my old man? ...That stubborn old goat, writing a letter." The young soldier tucked the letter into his chest.
地の文.倅は何と？ ……そうか、そうか。次の祭りには帰ると。長生きはするもんじゃのう: What did my boy say? ...I see, I see. He'll be home for the next festival. It pays to live a long life
地の文.来てくれたんだ！ ちょうど新しいのができたところ。持ってって: You came! I just finished a new one. Take it
地の文.薬師さまから、また赤い線の手紙が来たの。うれしいな: Another letter with red lines from the town apothecary came. I'm so happy
地の文.怪我したら、すぐ来てね。練習台……じゃなくて、患者さんとして: If you get hurt, come right away. As practice... I mean, as a patient
地の文.こんにちは！ あたしナナ。村でたった一人の薬師見習い……の、つもり。ねえ、ちょっ: Hello! I'm Nana. The village's only apprentice apothecary... or so I like to think. Hey, could you lend me a hand?
地の文.熱を出した子がいて、薬草が足りないの。二つ分けてくれない？: A child has a fever and I don't have enough herbs. Could you spare two?
地の文.ありがとう！ これで薬を煎じられる。お礼に、あたしの作った回復薬: Thank you! Now I can brew the medicine. Here's a potion I made, as thanks
地の文.森の薬草畑に魔物が棲みついちゃって、摘みに行けないの: A monster has moved into the herb field in the forest, and I can't go picking
地の文.畑が戻ってきた！ ……ちょっと踏まれちゃったけど、根は生きてる: The field's back! ...It got stepped on a bit, but the roots are alive
地の文.町の薬師さまに、あたしの調合の書き付けを見てほしいの。届けてくれる？: I want the town apothecary to look over my brewing notes. Would you deliver them?
地の文.「ほう、独学でここまで……。弟子に取りたいくらいだ」薬師は書き付けに赤い線を引き: "Oho, this far on her own... I'd almost take her as an apprentice." The apothecary began drawing red lines on the notes.
地の文.赤い線がいっぱい！ ……でも「見込みあり」って書いてある。これ、あたしの宝物にす: So many red lines! ...But it says "promising". I'll treasure this. This is for you
地の文.……炉の火は落とさん。それだけだ: ...I don't let the forge fire go out. That's all
地の文.刃が欠けたら、持ってこい。鍬と同じ要領で直してやる: If your blade chips, bring it here. I'll fix it the same way I fix a hoe
地の文.……客か。ブラムだ。鍬と鎌しか作らん、村の鍛冶屋だ。……ついでに頼みがある: ...A customer. I'm Bram. Village smith; I only make hoes and sickles. ...While you're here, a request
地の文.炉はあるが、鉄がない。鉄鉱石を二つ持ってきてくれ: I've got a forge but no iron. Bring me two iron ores
地の文.いい鉄だ。礼に、砥石をやる。刃物の隣に置いておけ: Good iron. Take a whetstone as thanks. Keep it next to a blade
地の文.鍛冶場の裏の洞に、何か棲みついた。夜になると炉の火を覗きにくる: Something's moved into the cave behind the smithy. At night it comes to peer at the forge fire
地の文.が洞の奥から這い出てきた。: crawled out from deep in the cave.
地の文.……助かった。これで夜も炉に火を入れられる: ...That helps. Now I can light the forge at night too
地の文.昔世話になった先輩に、借りた金槌を返せずにいる。……詫びの手紙だ。町の鍛冶場へ頼: I still haven't returned a hammer I borrowed from a senior who looked after me long ago. ...It's a letter of apology. To the smithy in town, please
地の文.「ブラムの奴、まだ気にしてたのか。金槌はくれてやったつもりだったんだがな」鍛冶師: "Bram's still worried about that? I meant for him to keep the hammer." The smith laughed.
地の文.……そうか。あの人らしい。礼だ。俺が一番いい鉄で打った砥石だ: ...I see. That's just like him. Thanks. A whetstone I forged from my best iron
地の文.いらっしゃい。旅の方に持たせたくて、取っておいたの: Welcome. I saved this to give to a traveller
地の文.町から、また注文が来たのよ。糸を通す手が止まらないわ: Another order came from town. My hands can't stop threading

地の文.獅子王レオナールは、大陸王として冠を戴いた。剣で平らげた国々には、麦の種と騎士の: Lion King Leonard was crowned king of the continent. Wheat seed and the knights' code were handed out to the nations subdued by the sword, and the blue lion banner flew over every road. At the king's side, the stranger once called a "dud" came in time to be called "Knight Commander".
地の文.大陸じゅうの都に、ベルカの商館が建った。国境の関所は市場に変わり、大商会頭ミレー: Belka trading houses went up in every capital on the continent. Border checkpoints turned into markets, and there is no longer a single deal not recorded in Grand Merchant Mireille's ledger. Gold coin finished the unification that the sword began. On the back of the new continental gold coin is engraved the stranger's profile.
地の文.樹冠の女王エルウェは、征した国々の都に若木を一本ずつ植えさせた。百年もすれば、大: Canopy Queen Elwe had a sapling planted in the capital of each nation she conquered. In a hundred years, the continent will be a single forest. The stranger who sheathed their sword was called "the First Branch" by the forest people, and given a small hermitage at the roots of the World Tree.
地の文.鉄髭王ボルドは、征した国々の武具をすべて炉に投げ込み、一本の巨大な槌を鍛え上げた: Ironbeard King Bord threw every weapon of the conquered nations into the forge and hammered them into one giant hammer. "No one has a reason to point swords at each other any more. All the iron is here." Only one blade, the stranger's sword, was not melted down; it hangs on the wall of the king's hall.
地の文.大導師セラフィナは、大陸じゅうの召喚陣を封じる法を布いた。喚ばれ、捨てられる者は: Archmage Seraphina decreed a law sealing every summoning circle on the continent. No one will ever be summoned and thrown away again. The stranger who unified the continent refused to the end to have their name attached to that law. "Let it end with me."
地の文.大陸のすべての都に、黒鉄の旗が翻った。魔王ヴァルガは玉座から立ち上がり、異邦人に: Black iron banners flew over every capital on the continent. Demon Lord Varga rose from his throne and told the stranger: "We too are descendants of the summoned and thrown away. — At last, we have a place to return to." The age of men was over. Those who ended it were the ones the age of men had thrown away.
地の文.魔王を討った英雄の名は、: The name of the hero who slew the Demon Lord,

The clock hasn't moved a single minute since the moment you were summoned. All that remains are a hundred days of scars and the weight of your bag.{0}

地の文.魔神をも討った者の名は、千年先まで語り継がれるだろう。: The name of the one who slew even the Demon God will be told for a thousand years.
地の文.あなたを「外れ」と呼んだ声は、もうどこからも聞こえない。: The voice that called you a "dud" can no longer be heard anywhere.
地の文.{0}吟遊詩人は「外れ」と呼ばれた異邦人の歌を歌う。帰る道は探さなかった。ここが: {0}the bards sing the song of the stranger called a "dud". You never looked for a way home. This is your world now.{1}{2}
地の文.戦火が店先まで届かないことを祈りながら。: Praying that the flames of war never reach the shop front.
地の文.{0}の一角に、小さな店の看板が掛かった。{1}異邦の珍しい知恵を売る店主として: In a corner of {0}, a small shop sign was hung. {1}As the shopkeeper who sells rare otherworld wisdom, you would in time be known to everyone in town.{2}
地の文.大陸はすでに魔王のものだ。: The continent already belongs to the Demon Lord.
地の文.人間の国々が陥ちるのは、時間の問題だろう。: The fall of the human nations is only a matter of time.
地の文.あなたは仮面を外し、素顔のまま魔王の傍らに立った。喚んで捨てた世界に、義理立てす: You removed the mask and stood beside the Demon Lord with your own face. You owe nothing to a world that summoned you and threw you away.{0} — This too is one way a stranger can live.
地の文.\n\n魔王を討ち、諸国を平らげた剣は、やがて伝説になった。: The sword that slew the Demon Lord and subdued the nations in time became legend.
地の文.その日、魔王城は跡形もなく吹き飛んだ。大陸の地図には、新しい湖がひとつ増えた。\:
That day, the Demon Castle was blown away without a trace. A new lake was added to the map of the continent.

What became of the goddess afterwards, no one knows. But they say soot-covered white feathers sometimes fall from the sky. The stranger's name lives on in children's playground songs as "the Bomber".
地の文.その夜、魔王城の玉座の間で、大陸で初めてのライブが開かれた。最前列では角の生えた:
That night, in the throne room of the Demon Castle, the continent's first live concert was held. In the front row, a large horned shadow waved a glow stick, and beside it a white woman cheered through her tears.

The Demon Army disbanded within the month, and fan club branches opened in every capital on the continent. The songs of the stranger who ended the war without ever drawing a sword are still sung somewhere today.

Morning of day {0}. Far away, the Otherworld Gate apparently opened, and then closed. You didn't get out of your futon.

What became of the Demon Lord, what became of the nations, you don't know. You don't need to. At the entrance to the ruins, a sign hangs today as always — "DO NOT DISTURB".
地の文.かつて剣を捧げた国の旗も、例外ではなかった。: Not even the flag of the nation you once swore your sword to was an exception.
地の文.\n\n玉座の脇には、獅子の紋を削った盾が一枚、飾られている。その縁には、鴉の羽: Beside the throne hangs a shield with the lion crest scraped off. A single raven feather is still tied to its rim.

In a world that summoned and threw them away, the summoned one reigned as king.{0} The human nations' flags were burned one by one, and in time the names of nations vanished from the map of the continent. The promise exchanged in the throne room spread across the continent within a month. Demon Lord Varga withdrew his troops to where the barrier had been, and Lion King Leonard released the oath of sealing his ancestors swore a thousand years ago. Only one agreement was made first — that no one would ever again summon a person from another world.

Lionel and Noctia built a small house beside the Summoning Ruins. A place where humans and demons talk at the same table for the first time. At the far end of that table there is always one empty seat. The seat of the stranger, who was on neither side.
地の文.魔王軍との戦は、これからが本番だ。: The war with the Demon Army is only just beginning.

You have no reason to wag your tail at the world of men that summoned you and threw you away.{0} The Demon Lord, they say, sometimes pats your head from the throne. — This too is one way a stranger can live.

"We too are descendants of the summoned and thrown away. — So were you." The age of men was over. Those who ended it were the ones the age of men had thrown away, and a single {1}.

Why a beast with no sword and no words at the head? To those who asked, the soldiers answered with a laugh: "Without that one, we'd never have made it this far."{2}

地の文.その卓のいちばん端には、いつも空いた席がひとつある。どちらの側でもなかった、異邦: At the far end of that table there is always one empty seat. The seat of the stranger, who was on neither side.
地の文.その卓の足元には、いつも水を張った皿がひとつ置かれている。どちらの側でもなかった: At the foot of that table there is always a single dish of water. A dish for the {0}, who was on neither side.
地の文.あなたは布団から出なかった。: You didn't get out of your futon.
地の文.あなたは遺跡の日だまりで丸くなったまま、動かなかった。: You stayed curled up in a sunny spot in the ruins and didn't move.
地の文.\n\n異界の土の下で眠る{0}の首輪には、知らない文字で、誰かの名前が刻まれて: On the collar of the {0} sleeping beneath otherworld soil, someone's name was carved in letters no one knew.
地の文.\n\nこの地の人々は今も、異界から来た一匹の{0}の話をする。言葉は通じなかっ: The people of this land still tell of the {0} who came from another world. Its words couldn't be understood, but it cared for its companions more than anyone.
地の文.\n\n獅子王は、ついに息子の行方を知ることはなかった。召喚の遺跡の外れには、名: The Lion King never learned what became of his son. At the edge of the Summoning Ruins, two nameless graves lie side by side, as if huddled together.
地の文.門の光の中で、背後に誰かの視線を感じた。黒い外套の男が、届かない剣を握りしめて立: In the light of the gate, you felt someone's gaze at your back. A man in a black cloak stood frozen, gripping a sword that could no longer reach you.
地の文.今もどこかの街道で、黒い外套の男があなたを探しているという。: They say that even now, on some road somewhere, a man in a black cloak is searching for you.
地の文.主を失った魔王城の塔から、白い髪の姫と、痩せた金の髪の騎士が解き放たれた。二人は: From the tower of the masterless Demon Castle, a white-haired princess and a thin, golden-haired knight were set free. The two vanished into the southern forest, close together. They say they never spoke your name again.
地の文.魔王城ノクスの奥の塔からは、今も夜ごと、人の国の歌が聞こえるという。地下の牢の騎: They say that even now, night after night, songs of the human lands can be heard from the tower deep in Demon Castle Nox. Only the demon soldiers know that the knight in the dungeon below hums softly along.
地の文.ノクティアは父の亡骸に黒いヴェールを掛け、それでも和平の席に着いた。「父の恨みは: Noctia draped a black veil over her father's body, and still took her seat at the peace table. "I will end my father's hatred." Lionel was always at her side.
地の文.ノクティアは、玉座の間の扉の外で父の最期を聞いた。一晩泣いて、翌朝、残された魔族: Noctia heard of her father's end outside the door of the throne room. She wept all night, and the next morning went to the remaining demons. As an envoy of peace. Lionel was always at her side.
地の文.魔王が倒れた報せを、ノクティアは賢者の庵で聞いた。一晩泣いて、翌朝、残された魔族: Noctia heard the news of the Demon Lord's fall at the Sage's Hermitage. She wept all night, and the next morning went to the remaining demons. As an envoy of peace. They say Lionel caught up with her three days later.
地の文.\n\n異界の門の跡には、小さな石碑が建っている。刻まれているのは、あの日、門の: A small stone monument stands at the remains of the Otherworld Gate. Carved on it are the names of those who rushed to the gate that day.
地の文.\n\n異界の門の跡からは、今も黒い霧が少しずつ溢れ出しているという。: They say black mist still trickles out from the remains of the Otherworld Gate.
地の文.\n\n西の山の頂には、古竜の骨が今も横たわっている。鉱夫たちはその前を通るとき: The ancient dragon's bones still lie on the summit of the western mountain. They say miners take off their caps when they pass.
地の文.\n\n晴れた日には、大陸の空を赤い竜が横切っていく。背に乗る者の姿を見たという: On clear days, a red dragon crosses the continent's sky. Stories of those who've seen someone riding its back became the children's favourite fairy tale.
地の文.\n\n西の山の古竜は、今も目覚めたままだ。山すその街では、夜ごと空が赤く染まる: The Ancient Dragon of the Western Mountain is still awake. In the towns at the foot of the mountain, they say the sky turns red every night.
地の文.門の前には、冒険者たちが全員そろっていた。誰も引き留めなかった。ただ、あの夜と同: All the adventurers had gathered before the gate. No one tried to stop you. They only raised their cups as on that night, and watched the stranger go.
地の文.あなたの墓には名が刻まれた。刻んだのは、あの夜、同じ焚き火を囲んだ者たちだ。信条: A name was carved on your grave. It was carved by those who sat around the same campfire that night. They say that these people of differing beliefs gather in the same place just once a year.
地の文.あの夜の焚き火の約束は、いまも生きている。困ったときには、大陸のどこからでも誰か: The promise of that night's campfire still lives. When there's trouble, someone comes running from anywhere on the continent. — The stranger who was summoned and thrown away became the one with the most friends in this world.
地の文.門の手前で、ゴーレムが足を止めた。鉄の体は、光の向こうへは行けない。核の光が二度: Just short of the gate, the golem stopped. Its iron body cannot go beyond the light. The core's light blinked slowly, twice. "...GOODBYE, MASTER." Words you don't remember teaching it. When you looked back, the golem was still holding up one arm.
地の文.ゴーレムは今日も、あなたの後ろを歩いている。言葉はほとんど覚えなかったが、日が暮: The golem still walks behind you today. It hardly learned any words, but when the sun sets, it always says just one thing. "MASTER. TODAY. TOGETHER."
地の文.傭兵ガルドは最後の報酬を受け取らなかった。「金の要らない仕事も、たまにはある」: Garde the Mercenary refused his final payment. "Sometimes there's work that doesn't need paying."
地の文.門の前で、ガルドは背を向けたまま片手を挙げた。「達者でな、相棒」: At the gate, Garde raised one hand without turning around. "Take care, partner."
地の文.ガルドはあなたの剣を墓標に立て、一晩そこを動かなかった。: Garde planted your sword as a grave marker and did not leave it all night.
地の文.聖騎士セリアは、あなたの名を祈りの言葉に加えた。: Celia the Paladin added your name to her prayers.
地の文.門の光の前で、セリアは剣を捧げて一礼した。「あなたの世界にも、どうか加護を」: Before the light of the gate, Celia offered up her sword and bowed. "May your world be blessed as well."
地の文.セリアはあなたの亡骸に外套を掛け、長い祈りを捧げた。: Celia laid her cloak over your body and prayed for a long time.
地の文.盗賊ニコは足を洗った——と本人は言っている。あなたの財布は、今も無事だ。: Nico the Thief has gone straight — or so they claim. Your purse is still safe.
地の文.門をくぐる直前、ポケットに小さな重みを感じた。ニコがこっそり入れた、あの幸運の護: Just before passing through the gate, you felt a small weight in your pocket. It was that lucky charm, slipped in by Nico.
地の文.ニコは泣きながら、あなたの鞄には指一本触れなかった。: Nico wept, and never laid a finger on your bag.
地の文.魔導士ルカは一冊の本を書き上げた。題は『異邦人の理』。: Luka the Mage finished writing a book. Its title: "The Stranger's Logic."
地の文.ルカはあなたの言葉を一つ残らず書き留めた手帳を、生涯手放さなかった。: Luka never parted with the notebook in which she had written down every word you said.
地の文.狩人ミアは森に帰ったが、季節ごとに獲物を抱えて顔を見せに来る。: Mia the Hunter returned to the forest, but she visits each season with game in her arms.
地の文.門の光が消えるまで、ミアは矢をつがえたまま周囲を守り続けていた。: Until the gate's light faded, Mia stood guard with an arrow nocked.
地の文.ミアはあなたを森の一番高い木の下に葬った。: Mia buried you beneath the tallest tree in the forest.
地の文.黒騎士ザインは兜を脱ぎ、初めて素顔で笑った。: Zain the Black Knight took off his helm and smiled with his own face for the first time.
地の文.ザインはあなたの仇を討つまで、剣を鞘に納めなかったという。: They say Zain did not sheathe his sword until he had avenged you.
地の文.ザインは兜の奥から一瞥しただけで、何も言わなかった。兜の額で、黒い紋が脈打ってい: Zain only glanced at you from within his helm and said nothing. A black mark pulses on the helm's brow. (The sage might know something)
地の文.黒騎士ザインは兜を脱ぎ、初めて素顔で笑った。人の名を名乗り直すかと問われると、「: Zain the Black Knight took off his helm and smiled with his own face for the first time. Asked whether he would take back a human name, he only answered, "Black Knight is enough."
地の文.記憶を取り戻した異邦人は、この世界に残ることを選んだ。「帰る場所は、もう自分で決: The stranger who regained their memory chose to stay in this world. "I've already decided where home is."
地の文.二人の異邦人は、並んで門をくぐった。向こう側で互いを覚えているかは分からない。そ: The two strangers passed through the gate side by side. Whether they will remember each other on the other side, no one knows. Still, they did not let go of each other's hand.
地の文.あなたが倒れたとき、記憶を失った異邦人は初めて声を上げて泣いた。なぜ涙が出るのか: When you fell, the amnesiac stranger cried out loud for the first time, without understanding why the tears came.
地の文.歩きながら、記憶を失った者はしきりに胸元へ手をやっている。何かを締めていたような: As they walk, the amnesiac keeps reaching for their collar, as if adjusting something that used to be there.
地の文.野営の火を見ると、記憶を失った者は無意識に腰へ手を伸ばした。そこに、包丁が下がっ: At the sight of the campfire, the amnesiac reaches for their hip without thinking, as if a kitchen knife once hung there.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、峠を見上げるたびに、登る道筋を指でなぞっている。: Whenever the amnesiac looks up at a pass, their finger traces a climbing route.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、休むときも必ず背を壁につけ、入口の見える場所に座った。: Even when resting, the amnesiac always sits with their back to a wall, facing the entrance.
地の文.誰かが咳をすると、記憶を失った者はすぐに振り返った。手首に指を当てかけて、自分で: When someone coughs, the amnesiac turns at once, starts to reach for a wrist to take a pulse, then stops, surprised at themselves.
地の文.日が高くなるまで、記憶を失った者はなかなか起きてこなかった。本人は、それを少し恥: The amnesiac doesn't get up until the sun is high, and seems a little embarrassed about it.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、ときどき鐘の音に顔を上げる。何かに遅れるのを、恐れているように: The amnesiac sometimes looks up at the sound of a bell, as if afraid of being late for something.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、人の多い場所を通るとき、なぜか背筋を伸ばして笑顔をつくる。: Passing through crowds, the amnesiac straightens up and puts on a smile for some reason.
地の文.記憶を失った者の足音は、ほとんど聞こえない。本人も、なぜそう歩くのか分からないら: The amnesiac's footsteps make almost no sound. They don't seem to know why they walk that way.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、あなたの少し後ろを歩きたがる。呼ぶと、振り返るより先に体が向く: The amnesiac likes to walk a little behind you. When called, their whole body turns before their head does.
地の文.記憶を失った者は、日なたを見つけると、ついそこで足を止めてしまう。: Whenever the amnesiac finds a sunny spot, they can't help stopping in it.
地の文.砦の裏手、崩れた石垣の下に、ガルドは黙って酒を注いだ。: Behind the fort, beneath a crumbled stone wall, Garde silently poured out the ale.
地の文.証人の老書記は、震える手で帳簿の写しを差し出した。そのとき、戸口に影が差した。: The old clerk who was the witness held out a copy of the ledger with trembling hands. Just then, a shadow fell across the doorway.
地の文.——口封じの刺客だ！: — An assassin, sent to silence him!

地の文.牢の中の老いた騎士は、兜を脱いだザインの顔を見て声を失った。ザインは斧を振り上げ: The old knight in the cell lost his voice at the sight of Zain's unhelmed face. Zain raised his axe — and looked at you.
地の文.砦の門で、黒鉄の騎士がザインの素顔に気づいた。「呪いを捨てた裏切り者が、何をしに: At the fort gate, a black iron knight recognized Zain's face. "What are you doing here, traitor who cast off the curse!"
地の文.斧が落ちた。「……これで、人であった我は死んだ」: The axe fell. "...With this, the man I once was is dead."
地の文.斧は牢の格子を断ち割って止まった。「……斬る価値もない、か。貴様の言うとおりだ」: The axe split the bars of the cell and stopped. "...Not even worth cutting, eh. You're right."
地の文.ザインは兜を被り直した。「見届けた者がいる。それで足りる」: Zain put his helm back on. "Someone witnessed it. That is enough."
地の文.遺跡の石畳に、古い焚き火の跡があった。その脇に、あなたのものとよく似た鞄の跡が残: On the flagstones of the ruins were the traces of an old campfire. Beside it, the imprint of a bag much like yours.
地の文.🦹 ザインが兜の額を押さえて膝をついた。黒い紋が、音を立てて砕けていく。「……魔: 🦹 Zain pressed the brow of his helm and fell to one knee. The black mark cracked apart with a sound. "...So the Demon Lord is dead. The curse... is broken." (Zain the Black Knight's curse is broken)
