台詞.「それから——何万もの歓声の中にいた。……歌っていた気がする。最後の一曲まで」: "And—I was surrounded by tens of thousands of cheers. ...I think I was singing. Right to the last song."
台詞.「外を歩くのが、少しだけ怖い。ずっと部屋にいた気がする」: "Walking outside scares me a little. I feel like I stayed in a room the whole time."
台詞.「それから——部屋から出なかった。この世界でも、ずっと。だから今、こうして歩いて: "And—I never left my room. Not even in this world. That's why walking like this feels so strange."
台詞.「……昔、灰狼団という傭兵団にいた。グラン砦の戦で、雇い主に見捨てられて全滅だ。: "...I used to be in a mercenary band called the Grey Wolves. At the battle of Fort Gran, our employer abandoned us and we were wiped out. The only survivors were me and the captain who sold the band out."
台詞.「墓もない連中だ。せめて酒くらい供えてやりたい。……付き合ってくれるか」: "They don't even have graves. I'd like to at least offer them a drink. ...Will you come with me?"
台詞.「来ると思っていたぞ、ガルド」 磨かれた鎧の男が立っていた。団を売った金で、騎士: "I knew you'd come, Garde." A man in polished armor stood there — the former captain, who bought a knighthood with the money he got for selling the band.
台詞.「……終わった。二十年分の借りを、やっと返せた」: "...It's over. Twenty years of debt, finally repaid."
台詞.「金にならない仕事に付き合わせたな。この借りは、剣で返す」: "Sorry for dragging you into work that doesn't pay. I'll repay this with my sword."
台詞.「私は、アルデンの騎士団を追われた身です。上官の横領を告発して——握り潰されまし: "I was driven out of the Arden knights. I accused my superior of embezzlement — and it was crushed."
台詞.「証人が宿場町ロシェにいると聞きました。ですが一人では、もう一度立ち向かう勇気が: "I heard a witness is in Post Town Roche. But alone, I can't find the courage to stand up again."
台詞.「帳簿は獅子王のもとへ届けます。……ですが、騎士団に戻るつもりはありません」: "I'll take the ledger to the Lion King. ...But I don't intend to return to the knights."
台詞.「私の剣は、もうあなたの旅のためにあります」: "My sword is now for your journey."
台詞.「おいらが盗むのはさ、商都ベルカの孤児院のためなんだ。屋根が落ちそうでさ。冬まで: "I steal for the orphanage in Merchant City Belka. The roof's about to cave in. If it's not fixed by winter, the little ones'll freeze."
台詞.「宝石がひとつあれば足りるんだ。……盗んだやつじゃなくて、ちゃんとしたのがいい。: "One gem would be enough. ...Not a stolen one — a proper one. It's their roof, after all."
台詞.「……本当にくれるのかよ。へへ、参ったな」: "...You're really giving it to me? Heh, you got me."
台詞.「おいら、一生あんたの味方だぜ。これは盗めないや」: "I'm on your side for life. That's one thing nobody can steal."
台詞.「私の師は、賢者の庵の隠者なの。召喚術の研究を巡って口論になって、破門されたわ」: "My teacher is the hermit at the Sage's Hermitage. We argued over research into summoning magic, and I was expelled."
台詞.「あなたを喚んだあの術式——止める方法を、師は知っているはず。一緒に来てくれない: "That spell that summoned you — my teacher must know how to stop it. Will you come with me?"
台詞.「答えは出たな。術は理ではない、人だ」 隠者は一冊の古い手帳を弟子に放った。: "You have your answer. The spell is not reason — it is people." The hermit tossed an old notebook to his pupil.
台詞.「……ありがとう。やっと続きが書ける」 ルカは手帳を胸に抱えた。: "...Thank you. Now I can finally write the rest." Luka hugged the notebook to her chest.
台詞.「父さんは狩人だった。フェン見張り台の奥の森で、森の主にやられたんだ」: "My father was a hunter. The Lord of the Forest got him, deep in the woods past Fen Watchtower."
台詞.「あたし一人じゃ届かない。……あんたとなら、やれる気がする」: "I can't reach it alone. ...But with you, I think I can do it."
台詞.「……父さん、獲ったよ」 ミアは角のかけらを拾い、弓に結わえた。: "...Dad, I got it." Mia picked up a shard of antler and tied it to her bow.
台詞.「次は、あんたの番だ。あんたの行きたい所まで、あたしが道をつける」: "Now it's your turn. Wherever you want to go, I'll clear the way."
台詞.「部下の罪を被せられ、処刑台に送られた。前の晩、牢の窓に鴉が来て、魔王様の声で囁: "I was framed for my subordinates' crimes and sent to the gallows. The night before, a raven came to my cell window and whispered in the Demon Lord's voice: if you value your life, accept the curse. ...I was saved. The raven led me through a gap in the barrier."
台詞.「夢を見るんだ。足元に光の紋様が広がって、崩れた石畳に倒れている夢」: "I keep having a dream. A pattern of light spreads beneath my feet, and I'm lying on crumbled flagstones."
台詞.「召喚の遺跡——そこへ行けば、何か分かる気がする」: "The Summoning Ruins — I feel like if I go there, I'll understand something."
台詞.「……ここだ。わたしはここで目を覚ました。あなたより、ずっと前に」: "...This is it. This is where I woke up. Long before you did."
台詞.「名前はまだ思い出せない。でも、何をしに来たのかは思い出した」: "I still can't remember my name. But I remember what I came to do."

名詞：品物.遺跡に転がっていた剣。無いよりはまし。柄に、見たことのない文字で誰かの名が刻まれ: A sword lying in the ruins. Better than nothing. Someone's name is carved on the hilt in letters you have never seen.
名詞：品物.かつて喚ばれ、捨てられた誰かの剣。星の光で錆が落ちた。この剣を振るって倒した敵の: The sword of someone once summoned and thrown away. Starlight has washed off the rust. The blade answers for every enemy it fells (+1 attack per 10 kills, up to +12; at its peak it ignores armor).
名詞：品物.重く遅いが一撃が大きい。硬い敵に。: Heavy and slow, but each blow hits hard. Good against tough foes.
名詞：品物.場所は取るが間合いで勝る。戦闘が始まった瞬間に、まず一突きする（先制）。: Takes up space but wins on reach. Strikes once the moment battle begins (first strike).
名詞：品物.器用さで威力が伸びる。矢筒と隣接させ、鞄に矢を入れると化ける。: Damage scales with DEX. Place it next to a quiver and keep arrows in your bag and it becomes something else.
名詞：品物.鉱山で採掘ができる。武器にもなる。: Lets you mine in mines. Doubles as a weapon.
名詞：品物.魔力の矢を放つ。魔法は敵の装甲を無視する。魔導書の隣に置くと、杖の威力と速さの一: Fires bolts of magic. Magic ignores enemy armor. Next to a grimoire, it lends part of its power and speed to the grimoire (the staff still attacks).
名詞：品物.火球が炸裂し、敵全員を焼く全体攻撃。群れに強い。: Fireballs burst and scorch all enemies. Strong against groups.
名詞：品物.この世界では「理を記した書」として魔導書扱いされる。: In this world it counts as a grimoire — a "book of the world's laws".
名詞：品物.懐中電灯の光を魔石の力で固めた、光の刃。知力で振るう魔法の剣。暗所での判定+3。: A blade of flashlight beam solidified with a mana stone. A magic sword wielded with INT. +3 to checks in the dark. +1 attack for each mana stone stacked onto it (no limit).
名詞：品物.2回攻撃。砥石や毒の効果も2回ぶん乗る。: Attacks twice. Whetstone and poison bonuses apply to both hits.
名詞：品物.大きく薙ぎ払い、敵全員を斬る全体攻撃。場所を取る。: A wide sweep that cuts all enemies. Takes up space.
名詞：品物.戦闘が始まって7秒後に、一度だけ炸裂する全体攻撃。威力は当たり外れが大きい。装甲: Explodes once, 7 seconds into battle, hitting all enemies. Damage varies wildly. Ignores armor. Not used up (once per battle).
名詞：品物.アルデンの王子が初陣で使った、獅子の紋章の盾。2.5秒ごとに防壁12を張る。: The lion-crested shield the prince of Arden carried in his first battle. Raises a 12-point barrier every 2.5 seconds.
名詞：品物.物理ダメージを2軽減。補強鋲で、さらに硬くできる。: Reduces physical damage by 2. Rivets can make it tougher.
名詞：品物.物理ダメージを3軽減。かさばる。補強鋲で、さらに硬くできる。: Reduces physical damage by 3. Bulky. Rivets can make it tougher.
名詞：品物.物理ダメージを1軽減。頭の防具は、いちばん効果の高い1つだけが働く。: Reduces physical damage by 1. Only your best piece of headgear counts.
名詞：品物.物理ダメージを1軽減、回避+5%。脚の防具は、いちばん効果の高い1つだけが働く。: Reduces physical damage by 1, evasion +5%. Only your best piece of legwear counts.
名詞：品物.歌声を響かせる全体攻撃。魅力で威力が伸びる。装甲を無視する。宝石と合わせるとステ: Your singing hits all enemies. Scales with CHA. Ignores armor. Combine with a gem to make a Stage Mic.
名詞：品物.宝石で飾った舞台用のマイク。歌声がよく通り、魅力がいっそう威力に乗る全体攻撃。星: A jewelled stage microphone. Your voice carries further, and CHA adds even more power to this all-enemy attack. Combine with a star fragment to make a Star Mic.
名詞：品物.星の光を宿したマイク。魅力がそのまま威力になる全体攻撃。会心が出やすい。: A microphone holding starlight. CHA becomes raw power in this all-enemy attack. Crits often.
名詞：品物.面頬の付いた重い兜。物理ダメージを2軽減。頭の防具は、いちばん効果の高い1つだけ: A heavy visored helm. Reduces physical damage by 2. Only your best piece of headgear counts.
名詞：品物.顔を隠す薄い頭巾。視界が広く身軽になり、回避+8%。頭の防具は、いちばん効果の高: A thin hood that hides your face. Light and unobstructed: evasion +8%. Only your best piece of headgear counts.
名詞：品物.膝から爪先まで覆う鉄の脚甲。物理ダメージを2軽減。脚の防具は、いちばん効果の高い: Iron greaves from knee to toe. Reduces physical damage by 2. Only your best piece of legwear counts.
名詞：品物.森を駆ける狩人の脚絆。足音が消え、回避+10%。脚の防具は、いちばん効果の高い1: Leggings of a forest hunter. Silent steps: evasion +10%. Only your best piece of legwear counts.
名詞：品物.腕に括る小さな盾。2.4秒ごとに防壁3を張る。: A small shield strapped to the arm. Raises a 3-point barrier every 2.4 seconds.
名詞：品物.隣接する鎧（革鎧・鎖帷子・板金鎧）の軽減+1。1つの鎧に効くのは、いちばん強い補: Adjacent armor (leather, chain, plate) gets +1 reduction. Only the strongest reinforcement on each armor counts.
名詞：品物.隣接する鎧（革鎧・鎖帷子・板金鎧）の軽減+2。1つの鎧に効くのは、いちばん強い補: Adjacent armor (leather, chain, plate) gets +2 reduction. Only the strongest reinforcement on each armor counts.
名詞：品物.隣接する盾の防壁+2。1つの盾に効くのは、いちばん強い補強1つだけ。: Adjacent shields get +2 barrier. Only the strongest reinforcement on each shield counts.
名詞：品物.隣接する盾の防壁+4、間隔-10%。1つの盾に効くのは、いちばん強い補強1つだけ: Adjacent shields get +4 barrier and 10% shorter interval. Only the strongest reinforcement on each shield counts.
名詞：品物.隣接する刃物の攻撃に毒+1（2秒ごとに、たまった毒のぶんだけダメージ）。: Adjacent blades add +1 poison (every 2 seconds, deals damage equal to accumulated poison).
名詞：品物.隣接する弓の攻撃+3、間隔-10%。: Adjacent bows get +3 attack and fire 10% faster.
名詞：品物.空から落ちてきた星の欠片。隣接する魔法武器の攻撃+4。: A fragment of a fallen star. Adjacent magic weapons get +4 attack.
名詞：品物.古代の刻印石。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）が、戦闘開始と同時に一撃を放つ（先制: An ancient crest stone. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) strike as battle begins (first strike).
名詞：品物.古代の刻印石。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）の威力が1.5倍になる。: An ancient crest stone. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) deal 1.5× damage.
名詞：品物.二つの刻印が融け合ったもの。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）の威力が2倍になる。: Two crests fused into one. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) deal 2× damage.
名詞：品物.古代の刻印石。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）の攻撃が、敵全員に当たる全体攻撃にな: An ancient crest stone. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) hit all enemies.
名詞：品物.古代の刻印石。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）が2回攻撃になる。: An ancient crest stone. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) attack twice.
名詞：品物.二つの刻印が融け合ったもの。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）が3回攻撃になる。: Two crests fused into one. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) attack three times.
名詞：品物.食いしばり。戦闘ごとに一度だけ、倒れるはずの一撃をHP1で踏みとどまる（HPが2: Hold on: once per battle, survive a fatal blow with 1 HP (when you have 2+ HP; not against poison or fatigue). Only once even if you carry several.
名詞：品物.かばう。HPが半分を切った味方が単体攻撃で狙われたとき、持ち主が代わりに受ける（: Cover: when an ally below half HP is targeted by a single-target attack, the holder takes it instead (while the holder is above 30% HP). Give it to a companion and they will protect you.
名詞：品物.戦闘中にHPが0になったとき、一度だけ最大HPの半分で蘇る。使うと燃え尽きる。: When your HP hits 0 in battle, revive once with half your max HP. Burns away when used.
名詞：品物.鞄のどこにあっても、弓が1回多く射る（乱れ撃ち。矢の品は合わせて3つまで数える）: Anywhere in your bag, bows fire one extra arrow (volley; up to 3 arrow items count).
名詞：品物.矢束の効果に加えて、弓の攻撃に毒+1。: Like an arrow bundle, plus +1 poison on bow attacks.
名詞：品物.矢束の効果に加えて、弓の攻撃が魔法になり（装甲を無視）、攻撃+2。: Like an arrow bundle, plus bow attacks become magic (ignore armor) with +2 attack.
名詞：品物.矢束の効果に加えて、弓の攻撃が敵全員に当たる。: Like an arrow bundle, plus bow attacks hit all enemies.
名詞：品物.名匠の砥石で鍛えた短い刀。会心の一撃が3倍。打刀と両方持つと、どちらも会心4倍・: A short blade forged with a master whetstone. Crits deal 3×. With an uchigatana too, both crit for 4× with +10% crit chance.
名詞：品物.名匠の砥石で鍛えた刀。会心の一撃が3倍。脇差と両方持つと、どちらも会心4倍・会心: A katana forged with a master whetstone. Crits deal 3×. With a wakizashi too, both crit for 4× with +10% crit chance.
名詞：品物.鉄の頭をつけた棍棒。40%で相手をひるませる。: A club with an iron head. 40% chance to stagger.
名詞：品物.鎧ごと叩き割る鶴嘴。装甲を無視する。採掘にも使える。: A pick that smashes right through armor. Ignores armor. Also good for mining.
名詞：品物.魔族の仮面を綴じ込んだ禁書。闇の炎が敵全員を焼き、呪い（毒+2）を残す。: A forbidden book bound with a demon mask. Dark flame burns all enemies and leaves a curse (poison +2).
名詞：品物.世界樹の枝から削り出した弓。光の矢を2本ずつ放つ（魔法）。矢を入れると、さらに射: A bow carved from a branch of the World Tree. Fires two arrows of light at a time (magic). Arrows in your bag add more shots.
名詞：品物.星の欠片で目覚めた天馬を呼ぶ。地図上の移動が2.2倍速。サブバッグの容量+10。: Calls a pegasus awakened by a star fragment. Map travel 2.2× faster. Sub-bag capacity +10. Mounts and shoes don't stack; only the fastest counts.
名詞：品物.物理の教科書と魔石で組み上げた、異界の乗り物。地図上の移動が2倍速。サブバッグの: An otherworldly vehicle built from a physics textbook and a mana stone. Map travel 2× faster. Sub-bag capacity +6. Mounts and shoes don't stack; only the fastest counts.
名詞：品物.眠っていた機械人形の心臓。鞄に置くと3×5の枠ができ、頭・腕・胴・脚の枠をすべて: The heart of a dormant automaton. Placing it in your bag creates a 3×5 frame; fill every head, arm, torso and leg slot with items and the automaton wakes to fight beside you. Inside the frame, items of any shape shrink to one cell (they return to normal when taken out). Items in the frame are its equipment (no effect on you), and it only wields weapons placed in the arm slots. Items inside and outside the frame don't affect each other even when adjacent. Drag the core to move it with its contents; take the core out of your bag and its contents go to your sub-bag.
名詞：品物.ギルドから預かった荷物。届け先まで鞄に入れて運ぶこと。: A package entrusted by the guild. Carry it in your bag to the destination.
名詞：品物.魔王軍の刺客ヴェインが振るっていた、黒い双刃。2回攻撃で毒+2、戦闘の開始と同時: The black twin blades of Vane, the Demon Army's assassin. Attacks twice with +2 poison, and strikes as battle begins. Only found on Hard.
名詞：品物.二度死んだ骸拾いのオルムが握っていた杖。魔法の礫を放ち、与えた傷の30%だけHP: The staff held by Orm the Corpse-Gatherer, who died twice. Fires magic shards and restores HP equal to 30% of damage dealt. Next to a grimoire, it lends part of its power and speed to it (the staff still attacks). Only found on Hard.
名詞：品物.村人から預かった手紙。宛先の町で渡し、村へ戻って報せる。: A letter entrusted by a villager. Deliver it in the addressed town, then return to the village to report.
名詞：品物.鞄にある間、魔王軍はあなたを同族と見なす。占領地に入れ、闇市も使える。: While in your bag, the Demon Army treats you as one of their own. You can enter occupied land and use the black market.
名詞：品物.ただの枝。武器としては頼りない。: Just a branch. Not much of a weapon.
名詞：品物.ドルガンの鉱山で使われている。取り扱い注意。: Used in Dorgan's mines. Handle with care.
名詞：品物.魔力を帯びた刃。敵の装甲を無視する。砥石にも魔石にも反応する。: A blade charged with magic. Ignores enemy armor. Works with both whetstones and mana stones.
名詞：品物.異界の知識で再現した武器。一発が重い物理攻撃（装甲で軽減される）。もう一丁の拳銃: A weapon recreated from otherworld knowledge. Heavy physical shots (reduced by armor). Next to another pistol, you dual-wield and fire faster.
名詞：品物.銃身を長く鍛え直した銃。撃つ間隔は長いが一発が重く、会心は3倍になる（物理）。: A gun reforged with a long barrel. Slow to fire but each shot is heavy, and crits deal 3× (physical).
名詞：品物.剣の柄に、回転式の弾倉と引き金を仕込んだ武器。斬りつける瞬間に引き金を引いて、刃: A sword with a revolving cylinder and trigger built into the hilt. Pull the trigger as you strike to drive a shock through the blade. Strikes the moment battle begins (first strike), and benefits from blade add-ons like whetstones and vampire fangs.
名詞：品物.魔族の仮面の呪いを打ち込んだ大鎌。闇の刃が敵全員を薙ぎ（魔法なので装甲を無視する: A great scythe forged with a demon mask's curse. A dark blade sweeps all enemies (magic, so it ignores armor) and restores HP equal to 15% of damage dealt.
名詞：品物.刃に毒を仕込んだ短剣。当てるたびに毒+1。: A dagger with a poisoned edge. +1 poison per hit.
名詞：品物.隣接する弓の攻撃+3、間隔-10%、毒+1。: Adjacent bows get +3 attack, fire 10% faster, and add +1 poison.
名詞：品物.物理ダメージを4軽減。かさばる。補強鋲で、さらに硬くできる。: Reduces physical damage by 4. Bulky. Rivets can make it tougher.
名詞：品物.斬った相手を燃やす（毒と同じく2秒ごとにダメージ）。: Sets what it cuts on fire (damage every 2 seconds, like poison).
名詞：品物.穂先を鍛え直した長槍。戦闘が始まった瞬間に一突きする（先制）。: A spear with a reforged head. Strikes the moment battle begins (first strike).
名詞：品物.鉄を鋳足した戦斧。一撃がさらに重い。: A battle axe with more iron cast on. Even heavier blows.
名詞：品物.鉄の弦受けを付けた弓。矢筒の効果も受ける。: A bow with an iron string lock. Also benefits from quivers.
名詞：品物.宝石を嵌めた杖。速く、強い。魔導書の隣に置くと、杖の威力と速さの一部を魔導書に貸: A staff set with a gem. Fast and strong. Next to a grimoire, it lends part of its power and speed to the grimoire (the staff still attacks).
名詞：品物.星の欠片を戴いた杖。流星が敵全員に降る全体攻撃。魔導書の隣に置くと、杖の威力と速: A staff crowned with a star fragment. Meteors rain on all enemies. Next to a grimoire, it lends part of its power and speed to the grimoire (the staff still attacks).
名詞：品物.一体に雷を落とす。単体への威力は魔導書随一。: Drops lightning on a single foe. The strongest single-target grimoire.
名詞：品物.魔石で弾を込める銃。魔石の効果も受ける。もう一丁の拳銃と隣り合わせると、二丁拳銃: A gun loaded with mana stones. Also benefits from mana stones. Next to another pistol, you dual-wield and fire faster.
名詞：品物.6秒ごとに敵全員を吹き飛ばす全体攻撃（物理。装甲で軽減される）。: Blasts all enemies every 6 seconds (physical; reduced by armor).
名詞：品物.星の光を宿した剣。装甲を無視し、砥石にも魔石にも反応する。: A sword holding starlight. Ignores armor and works with both whetstones and mana stones.
名詞：品物.HP50回復。戦闘中、HPが半分を切ると自動で使う。: Restores 50 HP. Used automatically in battle when your HP drops below half.
名詞：品物.HP120回復。戦闘中、HPが半分を切ると自動で使う。: Restores 120 HP. Used automatically in battle when your HP drops below half.
名詞：品物.満腹+7。干し肉2つぶんを1マスに。: Food +7. Two jerkies' worth in one cell.
名詞：品物.満腹+4、HP8回復、3日間、筋力+1。: Food +4, restores 8 HP, STR +1 for 3 days.
名詞：品物.満腹+5、HP12回復、3日間、器用+1。: Food +5, restores 12 HP, DEX +1 for 3 days.
名詞：品物.HP30回復、3日間、筋力+2。酒好きへの贈り物にも。: Restores 30 HP, STR +2 for 3 days. Also a fine gift for drinkers.
名詞：品物.杖の先に盾の紋を刻んだもの。3.5秒ごとに味方全員へ防壁（3＋知力×0.67）を: A staff with a shield crest carved on its tip. Every 3.5 seconds, gives all allies a barrier (3 + INT×0.67). An adjacent mana stone shortens the interval. Next to a grimoire, it lends part of its barrier and speed to the grimoire's power and speed (it still raises barriers). Combine with holy water to make a Sanctuary Tome.
名詞：品物.聖水で清めた守りの祈祷書。4秒ごとに味方全員へ防壁（4＋知力×1）を張る。隣の魔: A prayer book of protection, purified with holy water. Every 4 seconds, gives all allies a barrier (4 + INT×1). An adjacent mana stone shortens the interval.
名詞：品物.鞄にある間、戦闘中3秒ごとにHPが3回復する。複数持っても効くのは1つだけ。: While in your bag, restores 3 HP every 3 seconds in battle. Only one counts.
名詞：品物.棘を編み込んだ鎧。物理ダメージを2軽減し、単体の物理攻撃を受けるたびに、攻撃して: Armor woven with thorns. Reduces physical damage by 2, and deals 4 damage back to the attacker whenever you take a single-target physical hit. Rivets can make it tougher.
名詞：品物.澄んだ音で術を乱す鈴。鞄にある間、敵の回復の技と防壁の技の効果が半分になる。聖水: A bell whose clear tone disrupts spells. While in your bag, enemy healing and barrier skills are halved. Purify with holy water to make a Bell of Banishing.
名詞：品物.戦闘の前に地面へ叩きつけると、煙に紛れて必ず逃げられる（使うとなくなる）。逃げら: Smash it on the ground before a battle to escape in the smoke, guaranteed (used up). Doesn't work in battles you can't flee.
名詞：品物.HP28回復し、毒を消す。戦闘中、HPが半分を切ると自動で使う。: Restores 28 HP and cures poison. Used automatically in battle when your HP drops below half.
名詞：品物.西の山の古竜の鱗を綴った鎧。物理ダメージを4軽減し、戦闘中、HPが少しずつ戻る（: Armor laced from the scales of the Ancient Dragon of the Western Mountain. Reduces physical damage by 4 and slowly restores HP in battle (2 every 3 seconds). Rivets can make it tougher.
名詞：品物.鎮めた古竜が授けた骨の笛。吹けば竜が舞い降り、背に乗せてくれる。地図上の移動が2: A bone flute given by the calmed Ancient Dragon. Play it and the dragon swoops down to carry you. Map travel 2.6× faster. Sub-bag capacity +12. Mounts and shoes don't stack; only the fastest counts.
名詞：品物.無間の奈落の底で、まだ脈打っていた黒い心臓。隣接するすべての武器の攻撃+5・会心: A black heart still beating at the bottom of the Endless Abyss. All adjacent weapons get +5 attack and +10% crit.
名詞：品物.吸血鬼の牙。隣接する刃物で与えたダメージの20%だけ、HPが回復する。: A vampire's fang. Restores HP equal to 20% of damage dealt by adjacent blades.
名詞：品物.かつて喚ばれた誰かの、小さなお守り。鞄にある間、魅力+1。隣接する武器の攻撃+2: A small charm of someone once summoned. While in your bag, CHA +1. Adjacent weapons get +2 attack and +10% crit.
名詞：品物.吹けば預けた馬が駆けてくる。鞄にある間、地図上の移動が1.5倍速（仲間も一緒に）: Blow it and your stabled horse comes running. While in your bag, map travel 1.5× faster (companions too). The horse carries cargo: sub-bag capacity +10. Mounts and shoes don't stack; only the fastest counts.
名詞：品物.鞄にある間、地図上の移動が1.25倍速。乗り物と靴は重ならず、いちばん速いものが: While in your bag, map travel 1.25× faster. Mounts and shoes don't stack; only the fastest counts.
名詞：品物.使うと3日間、地図上の移動速度+50%。乗り物や靴の倍率に足される（馬笛の1.5: Map travel speed +50% for 3 days. Adds to mount or shoe multipliers (a horse's 1.5× becomes 2×).
名詞：品物.使うと3日間、魅力+2。交渉の前に。: CHA +2 for 3 days. Good before negotiating.
名詞：品物.激レア。食べると能力値のどれか一つが永久に+1。: Ultra rare. Eating it permanently raises one random stat by 1.
名詞：品物.HP8回復。戦闘中、HPが半分を切ると自動で使う。: Restores 8 HP. Used automatically in battle when your HP drops below half.
名詞：品物.HP22回復。戦闘中、HPが半分を切ると自動で使う。: Restores 22 HP. Used automatically in battle when your HP drops below half.
名詞：品物.満腹+3、HP3回復。ドルガンで高く売れる。猫の大好物。: Food +3, restores 3 HP. Sells well in Dorgan. A cat's favourite.
名詞：品物.登攀・脱出の判定+2。荷を縛れるので、サブバッグの容量+6。: +2 to climbing and escape checks. You can tie down cargo: sub-bag capacity +6.
名詞：品物.元の世界から持ってきた懐中電灯。電池はなぜか切れない。暗所での判定+3。: A flashlight from your old world. For some reason the battery never runs out. +3 to checks in the dark.
名詞：品物.解錠の判定+2。ダンジョンの鍵付きの箱や、遺跡の小箱を開けるときに効く。: +2 to lockpicking checks. Helps with locked chests in dungeons and the small box in the ruins.
名詞：品物.野営時の回復量が倍になる。さらに移動中、自分と仲間全員のHPが毎日6%回復する。: Doubles recovery when camping. Also restores 6% HP to you and all companions each day while travelling.
名詞：品物.村・港町ミラ・賢者の庵の水辺で釣りができる（半日・器用判定）。サブバッグに入れた: Lets you fish at villages, the port town of Mira, and the pond by the Sage's Hermitage (half a day, DEX check). Works from your sub-bag too.
名詞：品物.使うとバックパックのマスを1つ広げられる。: Use it to add one cell to your backpack.
名詞：品物.鍵開けの針金と鉤縄をひとまとめにした道具袋。解錠の判定+4、登攀・脱出の判定+3: A pouch of lockpicking wire and grappling line. +4 to lockpicking checks, +3 to climbing and escape checks.
名詞：品物.寝袋に毛皮の幕を張り足した、小さな天幕。野営時の回復量が約2.6倍になる。さらに: A small tent made by adding a fur canopy to a sleeping bag. About 2.6× recovery when camping. Also restores 10% HP to you and all companions each day while travelling.
名詞：品物.鉄の枠で火を囲った灯り。暗所での判定+4。: A flame in an iron frame. +4 to checks in the dark.
名詞：品物.額に鉄の鉢金を縫い付けた頭巾。物理ダメージを1軽減、回避+12%。頭の防具は、い: A hood with an iron plate sewn over the brow. Reduces physical damage by 1, evasion +12%. Only your best piece of headgear counts.
名詞：品物.脛に鋲を打った狩人の脚絆。物理ダメージを1軽減、回避+12%。脚の防具は、いちば: Hunter's leggings studded at the shin. Reduces physical damage by 1, evasion +12%. Only your best piece of legwear counts.
名詞：品物.拡張布で裾を広げ、風をはらむように仕立て直した外套。回避+20%。: A cloak re-tailored with expansion cloth so its hem catches the wind. Evasion +20%.
名詞：品物.鉢巻に誓いの紐を結び合わせたもの。食いしばり（戦闘ごとに一度、倒れるはずの一撃を: A headband tied with an oath cord. Combines Hold on (once per battle, survive a fatal blow with 1 HP) and Cover (take single-target attacks aimed at allies below half HP).
名詞：品物.二つの刻印が融け合ったもの。隣接する大型武器（3マス以上）が、戦闘開始と同時に敵: Two crests fused into one. Adjacent large weapons (3+ cells) strike all enemies as battle begins, and keep hitting all enemies after (first strike, area attack).
名詞：品物.聖水で清めた鈴。鞄にある間、敵の回復の技と防壁の技の効果が4分の1になる。: A bell purified with holy water. While in your bag, enemy healing and barrier skills are cut to a quarter.
名詞：品物.宝石を嵌め込んだ腕輪。鞄にある間、筋力+2。: A bracelet set with a gem. While in your bag, STR +2.
名詞：品物.宝石を磨いてレンズにした片眼鏡。鞄にある間、知力+2。: A monocle with a lens ground from a gem. While in your bag, INT +2.
名詞：品物.交易品。都市で高く売れる。: Trade good. Sells well in cities.
名詞：品物.隣接する魔法武器の攻撃+2。交易品として都市で高く売れる。賢者は門の場所と引き換: Adjacent magic weapons get +2 attack. Sells well in cities as a trade good. The sage wants one in exchange for the gate's location, and it catches Luka the mage's eye.
名詞：品物.交易品。村や砦で高く売れる。: Trade good. Sells well in villages and forts.
名詞：品物.飲むとHP12回復、2日間、筋力+1。交易品としても都市や砦で高く売れ、酒好きの: Drink to restore 12 HP and gain STR +1 for 2 days. Sells well in cities and forts, and makes a good gift for adventurers who like a drink.

名詞：敵と技.奈落の底に棲むもの: That Which Dwells in the Abyss
名詞：敵と技.西の山の古竜: Ancient Dragon of the Western Mountain

名詞：国と地名.騎士と麦畑の国。千年前、魔族を南の結界に封じたのはこの国の騎士たちだ。剣と盾の質: A land of knights and wheat fields. A thousand years ago, its knights sealed the demons behind the southern barrier. Its swords and shields are the finest on the continent.
名詞：国と地名.金で動く商人たちの連合。何でも売り、何でも買う。: A league of merchants moved by gold. They sell anything and buy anything.
名詞：国と地名.深い森に暮らす弓の民。薬草に詳しい。: A people of the bow who live in the deep forest. Experts in herbs.
名詞：国と地名.山を掘り鉄を打つ頑固者の国。斧と鎧。: A stubborn people who dig the mountains and forge iron. Axes and armor.
名詞：国と地名.魔法使いが治める学問の国。異邦人を召喚したのはここの一派らしい。: A scholarly nation ruled by mages. A faction here is said to be behind the summoning of strangers.
名詞：国と地名.結界に閉ざされた地。: A land sealed behind the barrier.

名詞：人物.受ける物理ダメージを2軽減、最大HP+15。HPが半分を切った味方をかばう: Takes 2 less physical damage, max HP +15. Covers allies below half HP
名詞：人物.ガルドを仲間に連れ、酒を持ってグラン砦へ行く: Bring Garde and some ale to Fort Gran
名詞：人物.戦闘開始時、味方全員に防壁12。受ける物理ダメージを1軽減: At the start of battle, all allies gain a 12 barrier. Takes 1 less physical damage
名詞：人物.セリアを仲間に連れて宿場町ロシェへ行く: Bring Celia to Post Town Roche
名詞：人物.ニコに話しかけて、宝石を1つ渡す: Talk to Nico and give them a gem
名詞：人物.ルカを仲間に連れて賢者の庵へ行く（知力の判定がある）: Bring Luka to the Sage's Hermitage (involves an INT check)
名詞：人物.すべての武器が先制、会心率+10%: All weapons strike first, crit chance +10%
名詞：人物.ミアを仲間に連れてフェン見張り台へ行く（森の主との戦いになる）: Bring Mia to Fen Watchtower (leads to a fight with the Lord of the Forest)
名詞：人物.すべての武器の威力×1.25、最大HP+20: All weapons deal ×1.25 damage, max HP +20
名詞：人物.ザインを仲間に連れて黒鉄砦モルへ行く: Bring Zain to Black Iron Fort Mol
名詞：人物.筋力・器用・知力+1、最大HP+15: STR, DEX and INT +1, max HP +15
名詞：人物.記憶を失った者を仲間に連れて召喚の遺跡へ行く: Bring the amnesiac to the Summoning Ruins
名詞：人物.体が丈夫で、HPが半分を切った味方をかばう。戦闘の初めに吠えて敵全員をひるませ、: Sturdy; covers allies below half HP. Barks at the start of battle to stagger all enemies, and sometimes brings back meat after a win
名詞：人物.素早く、よく避け、会心が出やすい。ときどき何かを拾ってくる: Quick, dodges well, and crits often. Sometimes brings back something it found
名詞：人物.羊を飼って四十年の老人。町に出た息子がいる。: An old man who has kept sheep for forty years. His son moved to town.
名詞：人物.村でたった一人の薬師見習い。独学で調合を学んでいる。: The village's only apprentice apothecary, teaching herself to brew.
名詞：人物.鍬と鎌しか作らない、無口な村の鍛冶屋。: A taciturn village smith who makes nothing but hoes and sickles.
名詞：人物.村の布をすべて織る機織り。染めの色にこだわる。: The weaver who makes all the village's cloth. Particular about dye colours.
名詞：人物.村の材木をすべて切り出す、陽気な木こり。: A cheerful woodcutter who fells all the village's timber.
名詞：人物.村の祠を長く守ってきた老女。町に古い友がいる。: An old woman who has long tended the village shrine. She has an old friend in town.
名詞：人物.追い剥ぎに襲われていた行商人。助けると、合成の知恵を教えてくれる。: A peddler attacked by highwaymen. Help him and he teaches you about crafting.
名詞：人物.狼に追われていた薬草摘みの少女。助けると、弁当を作ってくれるようになる。: A herb-picking girl chased by wolves. Help her and she starts making you bentos.
名詞：人物.敵国の斥候に襲われた老貴族。助けると、武具庫の余りを分けてくれる。: An old noble attacked by enemy scouts. Help him and he shares spares from his armory.
名詞：人物.スライムに剣を呑まれていた見習い騎士。助けると、盾の鍛え方を教えてくれる。: A squire whose sword was swallowed by a slime. Help him and he teaches you how to reinforce a shield.
名詞：人物.森の妖精に迷わされていた少年猟師。助けると、矢の作り方を教えてくれる。: A young hunter led astray by a forest pixie. Help him and he teaches you how to make arrows.
名詞：人物.古い坑道の入口で大コウモリに追われていた女鉱夫。助けると、つるはしの作り方を教え: A miner chased by a giant bat at the mouth of an old mine. Help her and she teaches you how to make a pickaxe.
名詞：人物.賢者の庵のそばの湖で、ゴブリンに魚籠を奪われかけていた老漁師。助けると、釣り竿の: An old fisherman by the lake near the Sage's Hut, about to lose his fish basket to a goblin. Help him and he teaches you how to make a fishing rod.

名詞：職業.魅力+2、所持金+40G。値切りと交渉は得意だ。店の値切りと、依頼の報酬の交渉を: CHA +2, +40G. Good at haggling: you can try bargaining in shops and negotiating quest rewards up to 2 times.
名詞：職業.筋力+1・器用+1。包丁と弁当を持参。食事の効果が上がる（食べ物と、合成で作る料: STR +1, DEX +1. Brings a kitchen knife and a bento. Meals work better (food and crafted dishes give +1 fullness and +2 HP).
名詞：職業.筋力+2、HP+10。バックパックが一回り大きい。ロープと寝袋。: STR +2, HP +10. A bigger backpack. Rope and a sleeping bag.
名詞：職業.筋力+1・器用+1、HP+15。短剣と携行食を持参。野営に慣れていて、野営の回復: STR +1, DEX +1, HP +15. Brings a dagger and field rations. Used to camping: recovers more when camping. Trained in marksmanship: guns deal +20% damage and fire 10% faster.
名詞：職業.知力+1・魅力+1。回復薬2つと薬草。回復アイテムの効果が1.5倍になる。: INT +1, CHA +1. Two potions and an herb. Healing items are 1.5× as effective.
名詞：職業.能力値はすべて1。何も持たず、何の取り柄もない。そのぶん伸びしろだけはあり、能力: All stats are 1. No belongings, no strengths. But plenty of room to grow: stats and max HP rise more easily.
名詞：職業.知力+2。教科書と懐中電灯を持っていた。判定に失敗すると、15%でその能力が上が: INT +2. Carried a textbook and a flashlight. When a check fails, 15% chance to raise that stat (learns from failure). Magic weapons deal +15% damage (a knack for magic).
名詞：職業.魅力7、ほかは1。マイクの歌声で戦う。町や都の広場でライブを開いて稼げる（3日に: CHA 7, others 1. Fights with a microphone and song. Can hold live shows in town and city squares for money (once every 3 days). Cheering gives companions and pets +15% attack; winning battles doubles companions' affection gain. CHA alone can rise to 15 (9 for other jobs).
名詞：職業.器用4、ほかは2。打刀を帯びている。すべての武器の会心+20%、攻撃の間隔-20: DEX 4, others 2. Carries an uchigatana. +20% crit chance and 20% faster attacks with all weapons.
名詞：職業.筋力3・器用3・魅力3、知力1、HP+10・軽減+1。鞄は持たず、武器も装身具も: STR 3, DEX 3, CHA 3, INT 1, HP +10, damage reduction +1. Has no bag and cannot wear weapons or accessories. Fights with STR-based bites. Items go into companions' bags or are carried in the mouth (sub-bag; healing items can be used in battle, and items can be stacked to craft). Can rearrange companions' bags regardless of bond. Expansion cloth enlarges companions' bags. Cannot take a pet (dog/cat).
名詞：職業.器用4・魅力4、筋力2・知力2、HP+5・回避+15%。鞄は持たず、武器も装身具: DEX 4, CHA 4, STR 2, INT 2, HP +5, evasion +15%. Has no bag and cannot wear weapons or accessories. Fights with DEX-based scratches (fast, crits often). Items go into companions' bags or are carried in the mouth (sub-bag; healing items can be used in battle, and items can be stacked to craft). Can rearrange companions' bags regardless of bond. Expansion cloth enlarges companions' bags. Cannot take a pet (dog/cat).

名詞：実績.異界の門をくぐり、元の世界へ帰る: Pass through the Otherworld Gate and return to your world
名詞：実績.門を閉ざした者: The One Who Closed the Gate
名詞：実績.門を喰らうものを討ち、門の跡で旅を終える: Slay the Gate Eater and end your journey at the remains of the gate
名詞：実績.魔王を討つか、その討伐を支えて、英雄として凱旋する: Slay the Demon Lord, or support those who do, and return as a hero
名詞：実績.店を買い、この地に根を下ろす: Buy a shop and put down roots
名詞：実績.どこかの国に仕官する: Enter the service of a nation
名詞：実績.仕官した国（または魔王軍）のほか、すべての国を滅ぼして大陸を統一する: Destroy every nation but the one you serve (or the Demon Army) and unify the continent
名詞：実績.魔王軍の将となる: Become a general of the Demon Army
名詞：実績.自分の手で魔王を倒す: Defeat the Demon Lord with your own hands
名詞：実績.3国を対魔王同盟に加える: Bring 3 nations into the alliance against the Demon Lord
名詞：実績.好感度が最大の仲間と結末を迎える: Reach an ending with a companion at max affection
名詞：実績.1000G以上を持って結末を迎える: Reach an ending with 1000G or more
名詞：実績.この世界の冒険者全員との絆を最大にする: Max out your bond with every adventurer in this world
名詞：実績.魔王を15秒以内に倒し、真の姿をも討つ: Defeat the Demon Lord within 15 seconds, then slay his true form
名詞：実績.仲間を連れずに魔王を倒し、愉悦の女神をも討つ: Defeat the Demon Lord without companions, then slay the Goddess of Delight
名詞：実績.ベルカの闘技場で3連勝する: Win 3 straight bouts at the Belka arena
名詞：実績.バックパックをすべてのマスまで広げる: Expand your backpack to every cell
名詞：実績.バックパックを一度も広げずに、愉悦の女神を討つ: Slay the Goddess of Delight without ever expanding your backpack
名詞：実績.死者の地下墓所で骸拾いを討ち、亡者たちを眠らせる: Defeat the Corpse-Gatherer in the Crypt of the Dead and lay the dead to rest
名詞：実績.異界の門の跡で、門を喰らうものを討つ: Slay the Gate Eater at the remains of the Otherworld Gate
